json_path_semicolon.value: Путь JSON не может содержать точку с запятой
json_path_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: validation message when the typed path contains a semicolon, which the format comment uses as its separator; Apply is disabled.

json_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: first of three toggle buttons, selects formatting a JSON cell by extracting the value at a path.

number_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: third of three toggle buttons, selects number formatting (style, decimals, thousands separators). Noun.

path_help.value: Только сегменты через точку и [индекс]. При копировании и экспорте сохраняйте полный JSON.
path_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: dim help text under the Path input explaining the supported path syntax and that copying or exporting still uses the full JSON.

path_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: field label above the input where the JSON path to extract (e.g. dot segments and [index]) is typed.

preview_help.value: Предварительный просмотр обновляется при наборе текста. "Применить" добавляет комментарий формата -- sqlly к запросу.
preview_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog: dim intro text at the top of the dialog explaining the live preview and that Apply adds a format comment to the query; keep “-- sqlly format:” untranslated.

raw_preview.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Preview box: first dim line showing the original, unformatted sample cell value; {value} is that raw text, cut to 120 characters.

style_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Number tab: field label above the row of number-style buttons (fixed, percent, bytes).

template_help.value: Помощники: upper, lower, trunc:N, prefix:S, suffix:S, pad:N, default:S
template_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: dim help text under the Template input listing the helper names usable in a template; the helper names and :N/:S suffixes are syntax and stay untranslated.

template_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: field label above the input where a text template using {value} is typed.

template_required.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: validation message under the preview while the Template input is empty; Apply stays disabled until text is entered.

template_semicolon.value: Шаблон не может содержать точку с запятой
template_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: validation message when the template text contains a semicolon, which the format comment cannot hold; Apply is disabled.

template_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: second of three toggle buttons, selects formatting the cell through a text template. Noun.

thousands_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Number tab: checkbox label that turns grouping separators (e.g. 1,234,567) on or off in the formatted numbers.

diagnostic.value: Столбец '{column}' недопустим в списке выбора, так как он не содержится ни в агрегатной функции, ни в предложении GROUP BY.
diagnostic.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined column: error (warning on MySQL) shown when a selected column is neither aggregated nor in GROUP BY; {column} is that column. Mirrors SQL Server error 8120.

fix_label.value: Исправьте это: добавьте {columns} в GROUP BY
fix_label.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an ungrouped column: clickable accent link under the explanation that adds the missing columns to the GROUP BY clause; {columns} is a comma-separated list of names.

accepts_label.location: SQL editor → Signature help card (shown while typing function arguments): short lowercase label before the list of fixed keywords the current argument accepts.

blocking_label.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command: label before the reason the command can block the server or connection, warning before it is run.

column_in_table.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a column: fragment after the column’s type and nullability naming its owning table; {table} is the qualified table name. Lowercase fragment.

deprecated_since.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command → Title line: note after the command group/badges when the command is deprecated; {note} is the existing note, {since} the version it was deprecated in.

example_label.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a built-in function: dim label before the function’s usage example on the same line; keep the trailing space.

more_columns.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a table or view: final dim line after the listed columns when the card shows only some; {count} is how many columns are not listed.

more_forms.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a built-in function: dim line after the first four signatures when the function has more overloads; {count} is how many more call forms exist.

overload_note.location: SQL editor → Signature help card: suffix after the signature when the function has several overloads; {current} is the shown form’s number and {total} the number of forms. Keep the leading spaces.

routine_returns.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a stored procedure or function: dim line after the parameter list giving the routine’s return type; {return_type} is the SQL type. Lowercase fragment.

since.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command: fact fragment giving the server version that introduced the command; {version} is that version number. Lowercase fragment.

system_variable_note.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a system variable (e.g. @@VERSION): dim note on the title line after the variable name identifying what kind of word it is.

clipboard_empty.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard text contains no values to turn into an IN (…) list.

clipboard_too_large.value: Текст в буфере обмена слишком большой ({actual_bytes} байт); предел {limit_bytes}.
clipboard_too_large.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard text exceeds the size limit; {actual_bytes} is its size and {limit_bytes} the maximum, both in bytes.

clipboard_too_many_values.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard splits into more values than allowed; {actual_count} is the value count, {limit_count} the maximum.

selection_too_large.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Preview: warning shown in place of the preview when the selected text exceeds the size limit; {actual_bytes} is its size, {limit_bytes} the maximum, in bytes.

selection_too_many_values.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Preview: warning shown in place of the preview when the selection splits into more values than allowed; {actual_count} is the count, {limit_count} the maximum.

add_param_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: button that adds a query parameter declaration.

empty_markdown_cell.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Markdown cell: placeholder shown while the cell has no content.

expand_cycle.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when cell dependencies contain a cycle; includes the cell path.

expand_not_select.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced SQL cell does not contain exactly one SELECT statement.

expand_not_sql.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced cell is not a SQL cell.

expand_self_reference.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a cell references itself.

expand_unknown_cell.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced cell does not exist.

export_markdown_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that exports the notebook as Markdown.

export_jupyter_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that saves a copy of the notebook as a Jupyter .ipynb file that Azure Data Studio, VS Code and Jupyter open; keep “Jupyter” unchanged.

invalid_file.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when the notebook file cannot be decoded.

invalid_ipynb_file.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when a Jupyter .ipynb file chosen to open cannot be decoded; {error} is the parser's explanation.

unsupported_ipynb_version.value: Формат блокнота Jupyter {version} не поддерживается; сначала откройте и сохраните его в Jupyter (формат 4 или выше).
unsupported_ipynb_version.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when a Jupyter .ipynb file uses an nbformat version older than 4, which SQLly cannot read; {version} is the file's nbformat number.

markdown_done_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Markdown cell editor: button that finishes editing and returns to the rendered view.

newer_version.value: Этот блокнот был создан более новой версией SQLLY и не может быть открыт здесь.
newer_version.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when the file uses a newer notebook format version.

param_name_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: placeholder in the new-parameter name field.

parameters_label.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: heading above the parameter fields.

run_all_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that runs every SQL cell in dependency order.

run_all_completed.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: completion status reporting how many cells ran.

run_all_stopped.value: Выполнение остановлено на {cell_id} после выполнения {count} ячеек
run_all_stopped.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: error status identifying the failing cell and how many cells had already completed.

save_as_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that opens the Save As flow for the notebook.

save_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that saves the current notebook.

stop_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: button that stops the remaining queued cells.

unsaved_badge.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: badge shown when the notebook has unsaved changes.

writes_badge.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Cell: badge shown when the SQL cell may modify data.

convert_copy_button.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Footer: secondary button on the left that copies the converted list shown in the preview to the clipboard without changing the editor text.

convert_dialog_title.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: title of the dialog opened from Edit → Convert delimited list on the selected text, which reshapes a list of values (delimiters, quotes, wrapping).

convert_replace_button.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Footer: main button that replaces the selected editor text with the converted list from the preview. Verb.

dedupe_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: checkbox label that removes repeated values from the converted list, treating different letter case as different values.

delimiter_auto.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: first small toggle button, detects how the selected values are separated automatically.

delimiter_comma.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on commas.

delimiter_newline.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text into one value per line.

delimiter_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on semicolons.

delimiter_space.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on spaces.

delimiter_tab.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on tab characters (the Tab key character, not a UI tab).

find_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace: placeholder in the find input.

find_replace_all_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Replace row: small button beside Replace that replaces every match in the editor at once; very short space.

find_replace_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Replace row: small button next to the replacement input that replaces only the current match. Verb; very short space.

find_word_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Find row: small toggle button between “Aa” and “.*” that limits matches to whole words; very short space.

format_dialog_title.location: SQL editor → Column format list: title of the small dialog listing preset formats for a column, opened from the grid column header or editor context menu; {column} is the column name.

goto_line_label.location: SQL editor → Go to line bar (Ctrl+G): label at the top right of the editor before the line-number input; {line_count} is the total number of lines in the query.

input_delimiter_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the row of buttons choosing how the selected text is split into values.

invalid_regex.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar: red error line under the search row when regular-expression mode is on and the pattern does not compile; {error} is the parser’s message.

line_number_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Go to Line: placeholder in the line-number input.

output_delimiter_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for the text placed between values in the converted list.

prefix_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for text added before each value in the converted list.

preview_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the live monospace preview of the converted list. Noun.

quote_double.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: third small toggle button, wraps each value in double quote marks.

quote_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the three buttons choosing which quote marks wrap each value. Noun.

quote_none.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: first small toggle button, leaves values without quote marks.

quote_single.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: second small toggle button, wraps each value in single quote marks (apostrophes).

replace_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace: placeholder in the replace input.

suffix_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for text added after each value in the converted list.

wrap_width_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for the line length at which the converted list wraps; 0 turns wrapping off.

cancel_delete_button.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: button that closes the prompt without deleting the SQL file or folder.

change_folder_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): item that lets the user pick a different disk folder as the SQL library root.

delete_button.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: destructive button that permanently deletes the file or folder from disk. Verb.

delete_confirm.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: warning heading after choosing Delete on an item; {name} is the file or folder name.

delete_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: item that asks for confirmation and then deletes it from disk. Verb.

delete_warning.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: detail line under the heading warning that the deletion is permanent.

empty.value: SQL-файлов пока нет. Сохраните в библиотеку или перетащите .sql файлы в {path}
empty.location: Sidebar → Library: empty-state message when the library folder has no SQL files; {path} is the library folder on disk.

filter_placeholder.location: Sidebar → Library → Header filter: placeholder in the search input that narrows the library tree by file name.

name_placeholder.location: Sidebar → Library: placeholder in the inline input that appears in the tree when creating a new folder or renaming a file or folder.

open_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file: first item, opens the SQL file in a query tab (not shown for folders). Verb.

refresh_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): first item, rescans the library folder on disk to pick up added, removed or renamed files. Verb.

rename_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: item that turns the row into an inline name input to rename it on disk. Verb.

reveal_finder_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): item that opens the library root folder in the system file manager (Finder on macOS).

reveal_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: last item, shows the item selected in the system file manager. Verb.

chart_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly chart:” comment cannot be parsed; {error} is the specific parse error, followed by the expected syntax. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

computed_column_invalid.value: Этот вычисляемый столбец игнорируется — {error} (ожидалось `-- sqlly column: <Name> = <Excel formula>`, столбцы пишутся !Name, предыдущие строки !Name[1], фиксированные строки !Name[$1]).
computed_column_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly column:” computed-column formula cannot be parsed, so the column is dropped; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

conditional_invalid.value: Эта условная директива игнорируется — {error} (ожидалось `-- sqlly conditional: column=<name>; when=<test>; text=#RRGGBB; fill=#RRGGBB; bold`, или `scale=#RRGGBB..#RRGGBB`, или `bar=#RRGGBB`).
conditional_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly conditional:” grid colouring rule cannot be parsed and is ignored; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

focus_invalid.value: Эта директива фокуса игнорируется — ожидался номер результирующего набора, начинающийся с 1 (`-- sqlly focus: 2`).
focus_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly focus:” comment does not give a valid result set number, so the result-tab focus is ignored. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

format_invalid.value: Эта директива формата игнорируется — ожидалось `-- sqlly format: column=<name>; <format>` (см. Справка ▸ Директивы форматирования).
format_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly format:” column format comment has the right prefix but an unparseable body; points to the Help menu reference. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

format_spacing.value: Эта директива формата игнорируется — требуется точное написание `-- sqlly format:` (с пробелом после `--`).
format_spacing.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a format comment is written “--sqlly format” without the space after the two dashes, so it is not applied. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

grid_invalid.value: Эта директива сетки игнорируется — {error} (ожидается `-- sqlly grid [<n>]: order=<cols>; hide=<cols>; freeze=<n>; sort=<col> [desc]; group=<col>; filter=<col> <op> <value>; label=<col>:<column|off>`).

unlimited.location: Object Editor → Files: maximum-size value for an unrestricted database file.

update_statistics_now.location: Object Editor → General → Statistics: checkbox staging an immediate statistics update.

value_column.location: Object Editor → Configuration and Status: column containing setting or counter values.

yes.location: Object Editor → Properties and Parameters: affirmative boolean value.

add_button.location: Security → Redis ACL users: button that opens the new-user form.

add_user_title.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: heading shown while creating a user.

cancel_form_button.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: button that closes the user form without scripting changes.

channels_label.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: label beside the channel-patterns field.

channels_placeholder.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Channels: placeholder showing accepted channel-pattern syntax.

commands_label.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: label beside the command-rules field.

commands_placeholder.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Commands: placeholder showing accepted command-rule syntax.

default_user_delete_forbidden.value: Пользователь по умолчанию не может быть удален; отключите его (выключить) вместо этого
default_user_delete_forbidden.location: Security → Redis ACL users → Delete: validation error shown when trying to delete the default user.

delete_button.location: Security → Redis ACL users: button that prepares a reviewed ACL DELUSER script for the selected user.

edit_button.location: Security → Redis ACL users: button that opens the selected user's edit form.

edit_user_title.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: heading shown while editing an existing user.

enabled_label.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: checkbox controlling whether the account is enabled.

invalid_channel_pattern.value: "{token}" не является шаблоном канала (каналы начинаются с &)
invalid_channel_pattern.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Validation: error shown for an invalid channel-pattern token.

invalid_command_rule.value: "{token}" не является правилом команды (команды начинаются с + или -)
invalid_command_rule.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Validation: error shown for an invalid command-rule token.

invalid_key_pattern.value: "{token}" не является шаблоном ключа (ключи начинаются с ~ или %R~/%W~)
invalid_key_pattern.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Validation: error shown for an invalid key-pattern token.

invalid_selector.value: "{selector}" не является селектором; напишите каждый в скобках, например (~cache:* +get)
invalid_selector.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Validation: error shown for a selector not enclosed in parentheses.

keep_passwords.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: checkbox retaining the existing password hashes and showing their count.

keys_label.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: label beside the key-patterns field.

keys_placeholder.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Keys: placeholder showing accepted key-pattern syntax.

log_empty.location: Security → Redis ACL recent denials: empty state shown when ACL LOG has no entries.

log_loading.location: Security → Redis ACL recent denials: placeholder shown while loading the ACL log.

log_section.location: Security → Redis ACL recent denials: heading above the log grid including the read limit and row count.

no_password_needed.location: Security → Redis ACL users → Passwords column: value shown when the user has nopass enabled.

nopass_label.value: Пароль не требуется (nopass), если он не установлен
nopass_label.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: checkbox enabling nopass when no password hash is assigned.

password_label.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: label beside the new-password field.

password_placeholder.value: Новый пароль (необязательно; хранится как хэш SHA-256)
password_placeholder.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Password: placeholder explaining optional password entry and hashing.

permission_denied.value: {error} — этот пользователь ACL не может читать ACL; войдите как пользователь с +acl
permission_denied.location: Security → Redis ACL users → Load error: guidance appended when the current user cannot read ACL data.

refresh_button.location: Security → Redis ACL users: button that reloads users and recent denials.

review_explanation.value: Добавляйте, редактируйте и удаляйте сценарий ACL SETUSER / ACL DELUSER на вкладке запроса для этого соединения; ничего не изменится, пока вы его там не запустите. Изменения, внесённые с помощью ACL SETUSER, теряются при перезапуске, если сервер их не сохраняет (ACL SAVE с файлом aclfile или CONFIG REWRITE).
review_explanation.location: Security → Redis ACL users: footer explaining reviewed scripting and persistence requirements.

script_button.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: button that opens the reviewed ACL SETUSER script in a query tab.

select_user_first.location: Security → Redis ACL users → Edit or Delete: error shown when no user is selected.

selectors_label.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: label beside the selectors field.

selectors_placeholder.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Selectors: placeholder showing parenthesized selector syntax.

title.location: Security → Redis ACL users: pane title naming the active connection.

user_label.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor: label beside the user-name field.

user_name_no_spaces.value: Имя пользователя Redis не может содержать пробелы
user_name_no_spaces.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Validation: error shown when the user name contains whitespace.

user_name_placeholder.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → User: placeholder for the account name.

user_name_required.location: Security → Redis ACL user editor → Validation: error shown when the user name is empty.

users_empty.location: Security → Redis ACL users: empty state shown when ACL LIST returns no users.

users_loading.location: Security → Redis ACL users: placeholder shown while loading the user list.

users_section.location: Security → Redis ACL users: heading above the user grid including its row count.

invalid_utf8.value: строка {line} не является действительным текстом UTF-8 — записывать бинарные значения в кавычеках «\xHH»
invalid_utf8.location: Redis Import Command File → Validation: error identifying a non-UTF-8 input line and the binary escape format.

matches.location: Redis bulk action → Dry run: status showing the complete number of matching keys.

matches_capped.value: {count} совпадают — частично: скан ограничен клавишами {limit}; затронуты только они. Повторите после этого для остальных
matches_capped.location: Redis bulk action → Dry run: partial-match warning shown when the configured scan cap is reached.

matches_empty.location: Redis bulk action → Dry run: status shown when no keys match.

matches_stopped.value: {count} совпадение клавиш — частично: скан был остановлен до завершения; затронуты только эти клавиши. Повторите подсчёт остальных
matches_stopped.location: Redis bulk action → Dry run: partial-match warning shown after the user stops the scan.

noun_commands.location: Redis Import Command File → Summary: noun describing the number of processed commands.

noun_keys.location: Redis bulk TTL apply → Summary: noun describing the number of processed keys.

production_read_only.value: Производство только для чтения. Разблокируйте запись (1/5/15 мин) через индикатор на панели состояния или командную палитру, затем закройте и откройте этот диалог снова.
production_read_only.location: Redis key dialogs → Write gate: error shown when writes are locked on a production connection.

read_only_connection.value: Это соединение только для чтения: изменения ключей и импорт отключены.
read_only_connection.location: Redis key dialogs → Write gate: error shown when the connection policy prohibits key changes.

summary_complete.location: Redis bulk apply → Summary: completed result with no failures or skipped work.

summary_complete_failed.location: Redis bulk apply → Summary: completed result including failures.

summary_complete_failed_skipped.location: Redis bulk apply → Summary: completed result including failures and skipped commands.

summary_complete_skipped.location: Redis bulk apply → Summary: completed result including commands skipped by a discarded transaction.

summary_stopped.location: Redis bulk apply → Summary: partial result after stopping with no failures or skipped work.

summary_stopped_failed.location: Redis bulk apply → Summary: partial stopped result including failures.

summary_stopped_failed_skipped.value: {ok} из {total} {noun} успешно (остановлено ранее), {failed} не удалось, {skipped} пропущено (отброшена транзакция)
summary_stopped_failed_skipped.location: Redis bulk apply → Summary: partial stopped result including failures and skipped commands.

summary_stopped_skipped.location: Redis bulk apply → Summary: partial stopped result including skipped commands.

all_online.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Footer: appended health summary when every node is online.

all_stages_passed.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Connection trace: success note shown when every node passes every connection stage.

footer_initial.value: Узлы из CLUSTER SHARDS (CLUSTER NODES на серверах до версии 7.0) · только для чтения
footer_initial.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Footer: initial explanation of node sources and read-only behavior.

footer_summary.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Footer: cluster summary suffix identifying the pane as read-only.

nodes_empty.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Nodes: empty state shown when the server lists no nodes.

nodes_loading.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Nodes: placeholder shown while loading cluster nodes.

nodes_section.location: Explorer → Redis Cluster Topology: heading above the cluster-node grid.

not_healthy.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Footer: appended health summary listing unhealthy nodes and link states.

query_node_button.location: Explorer → Redis Cluster Topology: button that opens a new query tab whose first line runs commands on the node selected in the Nodes grid.

refresh_button.location: Explorer → Redis Cluster Topology: button that reloads cluster nodes.

remapped_summary.value: · {count} узлы набраны по другому адресу, чем указано (карта узлов или туннель)
remapped_summary.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Footer: appended count of nodes whose dialed address differs from the advertised address.

remapped_summary_one.value: · {count} узел набран по другому адресу, чем указано (карта узлов или туннель)
remapped_summary_one.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Footer: singular appended note for one node whose dialed address differs from the advertised address.

select_node_hint.value: Сначала выберите узел в сетке узлов, затем нажмите «Запрос по узлу».
select_node_hint.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Nodes: note shown when Query on Node is pressed before a node row is selected in the Nodes grid.

slot_summary.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Footer: summary of node roles and covered hash slots.

title.location: Explorer → Redis Cluster Topology: pane and detached-window title naming the active connection.

trace_button.location: Explorer → Redis Cluster Topology: button that runs connection checks against every node.

trace_empty.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Connection trace: note shown when the trace query returns no result set.

trace_explanation.value: Трассировка выполняет шаги «Проверки соединения» для каждого узла и сообщает, на каком шаге произошел сбой: поиск имени, туннель или прокси (с картой узлов), TCP, TLS, вход в систему, протокол и ping, база данных, CLUSTER INFO.
trace_explanation.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Connection trace: explanatory placeholder describing the stages checked on every node.

trace_failed.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Connection trace: failure note listing node stages that did not pass.

trace_loading.location: Redis Cluster Topology → Connection trace: placeholder shown while the trace is running.

trace_section.location: Explorer → Redis Cluster Topology: heading above the per-node connection-trace grid.

browse_button.location: Explorer → Redis Export Command File: button that opens the output-file picker.

cancel_button.location: Explorer → Redis key action: button that closes the dialog without running the action.

command_done.location: Redis key action → Completion: status shown after the reviewed command succeeds.

confirm_run_button.location: Redis key action → Review: second confirmation button shown when connection safety requires it.

confirmation_explanation.value: Это соединение требует подтверждения перед изменением данных. Нажмите «Подтвердить выполнение», чтобы выполнить точно команду выше.
confirmation_explanation.location: Redis key action → Review: warning shown when the connection requires a second confirmation before running.

copied_to_connection.location: Redis Copy to Connection → Completion: success status naming the copied key and target.

copy_button.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Database or Connection: primary confirmation button.

copy_connection_explanation.value: Сериализует ключ с помощью DUMP на этом соединении и восстанавливает его с помощью RESTORE на выбранном вами соединении — включая значение, тип и оставшееся время жизни. Оба сервера должны использовать совместимую версию Redis.
copy_connection_explanation.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Connection: explanation of DUMP/RESTORE and compatibility requirements.

copy_connection_title.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Connection: dialog title naming the copied key.

copy_database_explanation.value: Копирует ключ, значение и время жизни из {database} в другую логическую базу на этом сервере (требуется Redis 6.2 или выше).
copy_database_explanation.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Database: explanation of the source and version requirement.

copy_database_title.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Database: dialog title naming the copied key.

database_name_placeholder.value: Имя, например, сессии (пустой файл удаляет имя)
database_name_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Name Database: placeholder for the logical database's local display name.

export_button.location: Explorer → Redis Export Command File: primary confirmation button.

export_explanation.value: Записывает каждую клавишу, соответствующую {pattern}, в виде команд (SET, HSET, RPUSH, SADD, ZADD, XADD, JSON. SET, PEXPIRE) в файл, который Import Command File... запускает обратно; бинарные значения записываются как эскейпы \xHH, чтобы возвращаться байт за байтом. На сервере ничего не меняется.
export_explanation.location: Explorer → Redis Export Command File: explanation of matched-key export, binary fidelity, and read-only behavior.

export_limit_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Export Command File: placeholder for the maximum number of exported keys.

export_path_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Export Command File: placeholder for the output file path.

export_succeeded.location: Redis Export Command File → Completion: success status naming the output path and export summary.

export_title.location: Explorer → Redis Export Command File: dialog title.

export_write_failed.location: Redis Export Command File → File write: error shown when the output file cannot be written.

exported_fallback.location: Redis Export Command File → Completion: fallback status when the export has no closing summary comment.

file_type.location: Redis Export Command File → File picker: filter label for .redis and .txt files.

invalid_database.location: Redis key action → Target database → Validation: error shown for a nonnumeric or negative logical database.

key_missing.value: Ключ больше не существует в этом соединении
key_missing.location: Redis Copy to Connection → Source read: error shown when the key disappears before DUMP completes.

name_database_explanation.value: Отображается рядом с db{database} в проводнике, в представлении ключа и в диалогах ключа в этом соединении. Только SQLLY видит имя; сервер не изменяется.
name_database_explanation.location: Explorer → Redis Name Database: explanation of the local display name's scope.

name_database_title.location: Explorer → Redis Name Database: dialog title naming the logical database.

rename_button.location: Explorer → Redis Rename Key: primary confirmation button.

rename_explanation.value: Дает ключу новое имя; его значение и срок действия перемещаются вместе с ним.
rename_explanation.location: Explorer → Redis Rename Key: explanation of what renaming preserves.

rename_only_if_free.value: Только если ключ с таким именем еще не существует (RENAMENX)
rename_only_if_free.location: Explorer → Redis Rename Key: checkbox selecting RENAMENX instead of overwriting RENAME.

rename_overwrite_warning.value: RENAME заменяет ключ, который уже имеет новое имя; его старое значение теряется.
rename_overwrite_warning.location: Explorer → Redis Rename Key: warning shown when overwriting an existing target name is allowed.

rename_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Rename Key: placeholder for the new key name.

rename_title.location: Explorer → Redis Rename Key: dialog title naming the key being renamed.

replace_checkbox.value: Заменить ключ, если он уже существует там (REPLACE)
replace_checkbox.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Database or Connection: checkbox enabling replacement of an existing target key.

same_connection_database.value: Это собственное соединение и база данных ключа; выберите другую цель
same_connection_database.location: Redis Copy to Connection → Validation: error shown when source and target connection and database both match.

same_database.value: Это собственная база данных ключа; выберите другую
same_database.location: Redis Copy to Database → Validation: error shown when source and target logical databases match.

save_button.location: Explorer → Redis Name Database or Show Only Databases: primary save button.

target_connection_database_placeholder.value: Номер целевой базы данных (пусто = собственная база соединения)
target_connection_database_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Connection: placeholder for an optional target logical database override.

target_connection_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Connection: placeholder above the target-connection dropdown.

target_database_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Copy to Database: placeholder for the target logical database number.

target_exists_no_change.value: Ничего не изменилось: целевой ключ уже существует. Отметьте опцию перезаписи, чтобы заменить его.
target_exists_no_change.location: Redis key action → Completion: error shown when RENAMENX or COPY refuses an existing target key.

target_exists_replace.value: Ключ уже существует на цели. Отметьте «Заменить», чтобы перезаписать его.
target_exists_replace.location: Redis Copy to Connection → Completion: BUSYKEY error guidance enabling replacement.

target_refuses_writes.location: Redis Copy to Connection → Write gate: error explaining why the selected target connection prohibits writes.

title_with_database.location: Explorer → Redis key action: dialog title suffix identifying the logical database being changed.

visible_databases_explanation.value: Проводник отображает только эти логические базы данных для этого соединения в этом порядке — удобно, когда используется только несколько из 16 слотов. Запросы и инструменты все равно могут обращаться ко всем базам данных.
visible_databases_explanation.location: Explorer → Redis Show Only Databases: explanation of explorer filtering and unchanged database access.

visible_databases_placeholder.value: например, 0, 3, 5 или 0-3 (пусто показывает все базы данных)
visible_databases_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Show Only Databases: placeholder showing logical database list and range syntax.

visible_databases_title.location: Explorer → Redis Show Only Databases: dialog title.

apply_summary_in_database.location: Redis bulk key action → Done: status summary suffix naming the affected logical database.

browse_button.location: Explorer → Redis Import Command File: button that opens the command-file picker.

bulk_delete_apply.location: Redis Delete Keys by Pattern → Ready: destructive primary button deleting the counted keys.

bulk_delete_confirmation_placeholder.value: Введите количество совпавших ключей для подтверждения
bulk_delete_confirmation_placeholder.location: Redis Delete Keys by Pattern → Ready: placeholder for the typed matched-key count.

bulk_delete_count.location: Redis Delete Keys by Pattern → Edit or Checking: primary button starting the dry-run count.

bulk_delete_done.location: Redis Delete Keys by Pattern → Done: primary button closing the completed dialog.

bulk_delete_explanation.value: Сначала считает ключи, совпадающие с этим шаблоном, с ограниченным SCAN — при подсчете ничего не записывается. После подтвержденного удаления выполняется UNLINK пакетами до 500 ключей, размер пакета выбран так, чтобы Stop выполнялся примерно за секунду; отмены нет.
bulk_delete_explanation.location: Explorer → Redis Delete Keys by Pattern: explanation of dry-run counting, batched deletion, stopping, and irreversibility.

bulk_delete_running.location: Redis Delete Keys by Pattern → Applying: disabled primary-button progress label.

bulk_delete_title.location: Explorer → Redis Delete Keys by Pattern: dialog title.

bulk_pattern_placeholder.value: Шаблон глоба, с которым выполняется массовое действие, например, session:*
bulk_pattern_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis bulk key action: placeholder for the key glob pattern.

bulk_persist_checkbox.value: Удалить срок действия (PERSIST) вместо его установки
bulk_persist_checkbox.location: Explorer → Redis Set TTL by Pattern: checkbox selecting PERSIST instead of EXPIRE.

bulk_ttl_apply.location: Redis Set TTL by Pattern → Ready: primary button setting expiration on counted keys.

bulk_ttl_count.location: Redis Set TTL by Pattern → Edit or Checking: primary button starting the dry-run count.

bulk_ttl_done.location: Redis Set TTL by Pattern → Done: primary button closing the completed dialog.

bulk_ttl_explanation.value: Сначала подсчитывает ключи, соответствующие этому шаблону, с ограниченным SCAN — подсчет не записывает ничего. После подтверждения выполняется одна операция EXPIRE (или PERSIST) для каждого совпавшего ключа.
bulk_ttl_explanation.location: Explorer → Redis Set TTL by Pattern: explanation of dry-run counting and per-key expiration changes.

bulk_ttl_persist_apply.value: Удалить срок действия (PERSIST) у подсчитанных ключей
bulk_ttl_persist_apply.location: Redis Set TTL by Pattern → Ready: primary button removing expiration from counted keys.

bulk_ttl_placeholder.value: Секунды до истечения срока действия ключей
bulk_ttl_placeholder.location: Explorer → Redis Set TTL by Pattern: placeholder for the matched keys' lifetime in seconds.

bulk_ttl_running.location: Redis Set TTL by Pattern → Applying: disabled primary-button progress label.

bulk_ttl_title.location: Explorer → Redis Set TTL by Pattern: dialog title.

selected_delete_title.location: Explorer/Results → Redis key dialog: title when deleting keys selected in a results-grid key listing (followed by the database name).

selected_ttl_title.location: Explorer/Results → Redis key dialog: title when setting or removing the expiry of keys selected in a results-grid key listing.

selected_delete_explanation.value: Удаляет точно те ключи, которые выбраны в таблице и указаны ниже, с помощью UNLINK пакетами; ничего больше не трогается и откат невозможен.
selected_delete_explanation.location: Results grid → Redis Keys → Delete Selected Keys dialog: explanation above the list of keys that will be deleted.

selected_ttl_explanation.value: Устанавливает срок действия точно для тех ключей, которые выбраны в сетке, перечисленных ниже — один EXPIRE на ключ или PERSIST для удаления срока действия.
selected_ttl_explanation.location: Results grid → Redis Keys → Set TTL / Remove Expiry dialog: explanation above the list of keys whose expiry will change.

selected_keys_status.location: Results grid → Redis Keys dialog: status line saying how many selected keys the action will touch; {count} is the number.

selected_keys_more.location: Results grid → Redis Keys dialog: last line of the selected-keys list when more keys are selected than are listed; {count} is how many are not shown.

value_query_hint_json.value: Похоже, это значение JSON. Фильтр ключей сопоставляет ИМЕНА ключей с шаблоном, например user:* — он никогда не смотрит внутрь значений, поэтому это не выдаст ничего.
value_query_hint_json.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog: inline hint shown under the pattern when it looks like a JSON value (e.g. {"name": "bob"}).

value_query_hint_search.value: Похоже, это поисковый запрос. Фильтр ключей сопоставляет ИМЕНА ключей с шаблоном, например user:* — для поиска по значениям используйте FT.SEARCH на поисковом индексе.
value_query_hint_search.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog: inline hint shown under the pattern when it looks like a search-module query (e.g. @name:bob).

value_search_button.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog → value-query hint: button that opens a query tab searching values with FT.SEARCH.

value_search_running.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog → value-query hint: the search button's label while the dialog lists the database's search indexes.

value_search_no_index.value: В этой базе данных пока не существует поискового индекса, а для поиска значений он необходим. Создайте его с помощью FT.CREATE (например, FT.CREATE idx ON HASH PREFIX 1 user: SCHEMA name TEXT), а затем выполняйте поиск с помощью FT.SEARCH.
value_search_no_index.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog → value-query hint: note shown when the database has no search index to search values with. Keep the command example unchanged.

value_search_no_module.value: Этот сервер не смог вывести список поисковых индексов ({error}), поэтому значения здесь нельзя искать — необходим модуль поиска (Redis Stack или Redis 8). Фильтр ключей сопоставляет только имена ключей.
value_search_no_module.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog → value-query hint: note shown when listing search indexes failed (no search module, or not permitted); {error} is the server's reply.

value_search_script_comment.value:
Фильтр ключей сопоставляет имена ключей с шаблоном; это ищет ЗНАЧЕНИЯ ключей через поисковый индекс {index}.
Измените запрос (синтаксис поиска: @field:value, @num:[min max]) и запустите его.

default_pick_placeholder.location: Structure Editor → Columns: placeholder for a column default.

description_label.location: Structure Editor → Columns: label for the description field.

long_text_apply.location: Edit Structure dialog → expanded editor: button that writes the edited text back into the field and closes the editor.

long_text_cancel.location: Edit Structure dialog → expanded editor: button that closes the editor without changing the field.

long_text_values_hint.value: Одна запись в строке, без кавычек. Пустые строки игнорируются.
long_text_values_hint.location: Edit Structure dialog → expanded editor for ENUM/SET values: hint under the heading explaining the one-value-per-line format.

long_text_values.location: Edit Structure dialog → expanded editor: heading when editing the allowed values of an ENUM or SET column; {column} is the column name.

long_text_description.location: Edit Structure dialog → expanded editor: heading when editing a column's description (comment); {column} is the column name.

long_text_default.location: Edit Structure dialog → expanded editor: heading when editing a column's default value expression; {column} is the column name.

long_text_table_description.location: Edit Structure dialog → expanded editor: heading when editing the table's own description; {table} is the qualified table name.

expand_field_tooltip.location: Edit Structure dialog → Columns tab / table Description: tooltip of the small expand button beside a Default, Description or ENUM/SET Type field that opens a larger multi-line editor.

descriptions_hidden.location: Structure Editor → Overview: explanation when object descriptions are unavailable.

descriptions_read_failed.location: Structure Editor → Overview: description metadata-load error.

foreign_keys_followup.value: Загружены внешние ключи {count} — редактировать в последующем запросе.
foreign_keys_followup.location: Structure Editor → Foreign Keys: explanation of generated statement ordering.

header.location: Structure Editor → Header: table and database-engine subtitle.

indexes_followup.value: Загружены индексы {count} — редактировать имена/столбцы в последующем запросе.
indexes_followup.location: Structure Editor → Indexes: explanation of generated statement ordering.

manual_review.location: Structure Editor → SQL review: warning to inspect generated statements.

no_changes.location: Structure Editor → Review: empty state when no edits are pending.

option_default.location: Structure Editor → Columns: default option in a database-specific picker.

remove_button.location: Structure Editor → Columns: button removing a column definition.

review_explanation.value: Скрипты ALTER открываются в новой вкладке для просмотра — здесь ничего не выполняется
review_explanation.location: Structure Editor → SQL review: explanation of script delivery.

script_button.location: Structure Editor → Actions: button generating SQL for pending edits.

tab_columns.location: Structure Editor → Tabs: column editor tab.

tab_foreign_keys.location: Structure Editor → Tabs: foreign-key editor tab.

tab_indexes.location: Structure Editor → Tabs: index editor tab.

table_description_placeholder.location: Structure Editor → Table: placeholder for the table description.

table_placeholder.location: Structure Editor → Table: placeholder for the table name.

title.location: Structure Editor → Dialog: main dialog title.

field_tenant_column.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Fields: label above the input naming the tenant discriminator column; left blank, the built-in column names TenantId, AccountId, and OrganizationId are used (keep those names).

field_tenant_display_column.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Fields: label above the input naming the tenant table column that holds each tenant’s display name.

field_tenant_id_column.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Fields: label above the input naming the id column of the tenant table.

field_tenant_table.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Fields: label above the optional input naming the table that lists the tenants themselves.

mode_allowed.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Mode selector: segment that lets tenant filters work without ever warning when one is missing.

mode_allowed_description.value: Фильтры арендатора работают нормально; отсутствующие фильтры предупреждений не вызывают.
mode_allowed_description.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Mode selector: explanation under the selector while Allowed is chosen.

mode_off.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Mode selector: segment that turns tenant scoping off for this database.

mode_off_description.value: Определение арендатора отключено для этой базы данных, включая конфигурацию.
mode_off_description.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Mode selector: explanation under the selector while Off is chosen.

mode_required.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Mode selector: segment that blocks running a query that reads a tenant-scoped table without its tenant filter.

mode_required_description.value: Блоки выполняются, когда таблица с областью арендатора запрашивается без фильтра арендатора.
mode_required_description.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Mode selector: explanation under the selector while Required is chosen; Run is the toolbar command that executes the query.

mode_warn.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Mode selector: segment that warns when a tenant-scoped table is queried without its tenant filter.

mode_warn_description.value: Таблица с областью арендатора, запрошенная без фильтра арендатора, вызывает предупреждение.
mode_warn_description.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Mode selector: explanation under the selector while Warn is chosen.

save_hint.value: Изменения сохраняются немедленно и применяются при следующей проверке запросов этой базы данных.
save_hint.location: Tenant Scoping → Dialog footer: explanation that edits persist immediately and affect subsequent query validation.

title.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Title bar: dialog title naming the server and database being configured; {server} is the server name and {database} the database name.

title_default_database.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Tools → Tenant Scoping dialog → Title bar: dialog title when the connection has no database selected, so the server’s default database is configured; {server} is the server name.

generator_binary.location: Test Data Generator → Column: binary generator label.

generator_boolean.location: Test Data Generator → Column: boolean generator label.

generator_date.location: Test Data Generator → Column: date generator label.

generator_datetime.location: Test Data Generator → Column: date-time generator label.

generator_decimal.location: Test Data Generator → Column: decimal generator label.

generator_email.location: Test Data Generator → Column: email generator label.

generator_guid.location: Test Data Generator → Column: GUID generator label.

generator_integer.location: Test Data Generator → Column: integer generator label.

generator_json.location: Test Data Generator → Column: JSON generator label.

generator_name.location: Test Data Generator → Column: person-name generator label.

generator_text.location: Test Data Generator → Column: text generator label.

generator_time.location: Test Data Generator → Column: time generator label.

generator_word.location: Test Data Generator → Column: word generator label.

load_button.location: Test Data Generator → Table: button loading table-column metadata.

load_prompt.value: Выберите таблицу и загрузите её столбцы для настройки генерируемых данных.
load_prompt.location: Test Data Generator → Overview: initial guidance before loading columns.

loading_columns.location: Test Data Generator → Table: busy status while columns load.

no_columns.value: Для этой таблицы столбцы не были возвращены.
no_columns.location: Test Data Generator → Columns: empty metadata state.

no_insertable_columns.value: У этой таблицы нет вставляемых столбцов.
no_insertable_columns.location: Test Data Generator → Columns: empty state when every column is excluded.

null_percent_label.location: Test Data Generator → Options: label for the nullable-row percentage.

review_explanation.value: Сгенерированные INSERT-запросы открываются в вкладке редактора для проверки перед запуском.
review_explanation.location: Test Data Generator → SQL review: explanation of generated-script delivery.

rows_label.location: Test Data Generator → Options: label for the number of rows to generate.

rows_positive.value: Количество строк должно быть положительным целым числом.
rows_positive.location: Test Data Generator → Options: validation for the row count.

schema_label.location: Test Data Generator → Table: schema input label.

script_button.location: Test Data Generator → Actions: button generating test-data SQL.

scripted.value: Тестовые данные запрограммированы — проверьте перед запуском
scripted.location: Test Data Generator → Actions: success status with statement count.

seed_label.location: Test Data Generator → Options: label for reproducible random generation.

skipped.location: Test Data Generator → Generation: status counting skipped columns.

table_label.location: Test Data Generator → Table: table input label.

table_required.location: Test Data Generator → Table: validation requiring a table name.

title.location: Test Data Generator → Dialog: main dialog title.

type_nullable.location: Test Data Generator → Column: data-type label annotated as nullable.

unsupported_engine.location: Test Data Generator → Overview: unsupported-engine message.

detail_prompt.value: Выберите сеанс и нажмите Показать события и цели.
detail_prompt.location: Extended Events → Details: guidance before session selection.

detail_title.location: Extended Events → Details: title naming the selected session.

load_failed.value:
Не удалось перечислить сеансы событий: {error}

Для чтения метаданных расширенных событий требуется право VIEW SERVER STATE (или VIEW DATABASE STATE в Azure SQL).
load_failed.location: Extended Events → Overview: session-list load error.

loading.location: Extended Events → Overview: busy status while sessions load.

refresh_button.location: Extended Events → Toolbar: button reloading sessions.

review_explanation.value: Операторы управления сеансом открываются в вкладке редактора для просмотра перед выполнением.
review_explanation.location: Extended Events → SQL review: explanation of generated control scripts.

scope_database.location: Extended Events → Scope: badge for a database-scoped session.

scope_server.location: Extended Events → Scope: badge for a server-scoped session.

script_start.location: Extended Events → Actions: button generating session-start SQL.

script_stop.location: Extended Events → Actions: button generating session-stop SQL.

select_session.location: Extended Events → Actions: validation requiring a session selection.

show_detail_button.location: Extended Events → Sessions: button displaying the selected session definition.

title.location: Extended Events → Dialog: main dialog title.

unsigned_build.value: Обратная связь отключена в этой сборке: она была собрана без ключа подписи обратной связи, поэтому sqlly.app не может её принять. Официальные загрузки SQLly могут отправлять обратную связь.
unsigned_build.location: Help → Send Feedback, and Query editor → F2 Improve IntelliSense: warning in the status bar and a toast when the user tries to send feedback from a build compiled without the feedback signing key (for example, built from source), so sqlly.app would not accept it.

standalone_build.value: Обратная связь отключена в этой автономной сборке: она никогда не связывается с sqlly.app.
standalone_build.location: Help → Send Feedback, and Query editor → F2 Improve IntelliSense: warning in the status bar and a toast when the user tries to send feedback. Shown only in standalone builds (compiled with the standalone option), which never contact sqlly.app.

arrow_tool.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: second tool toggle button above the screenshot; draws numbered arrows pointing at parts of the screenshot. Short noun.

arrow_tool_tooltip.value: Нажмите на что-то и перетащите, чтобы нарисовать стрелку, указывающую на это (A)
arrow_tool_tooltip.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: tooltip on the Arrow tool button explaining press-and-drag to draw an arrow; (A) is its keyboard shortcut and must stay.

blackout_tool.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: third tool toggle button above the screenshot; draws black boxes that hide private data. Short verb or noun.

blackout_tool_tooltip.value: Перетащите, чтобы скрыть личные данные под черной коробкой (B)
blackout_tool_tooltip.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: tooltip on the Black Out tool button explaining dragging to cover private data; (B) is its keyboard shortcut and must stay.

cancel_button.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: secondary footer button that closes the feedback window without sending anything.

delete_button.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: small button after Undo/Redo, enabled when an arrow or box is selected; removes that annotation from the screenshot.

dialog_title.location: Help menu → Send Feedback: title of the separate window (and its title bar) where the user writes a message and annotates a screenshot of the app to send to the SQLLY team.

hint_arrow_tool.value: Нажмите на то, на что хотите указать, затем перетащите, чтобы разместить пронумерованный хвост стрелки. Стрелки пронумерованы — указывайте на них как #1, #2… в вашем сообщении.
hint_arrow_tool.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: hint line between the toolbar and the screenshot while the Arrow tool is active; explains drawing and that arrows are numbered #1, #2… for reference in the message.

hint_blackout_tool.value: Перетащите, чтобы скрыть личные данные. Закрашенные области удаляются на этом компьютере перед отправкой.
hint_blackout_tool.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: hint line between the toolbar and the screenshot while the Black Out tool is active; reassures that covered areas are erased locally before upload.

hint_screenshot_excluded.value: Скриншот не будет отправлен — только ваше сообщение.
hint_screenshot_excluded.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: hint line above the screenshot shown when the “Include screenshot” box is unticked, confirming only the text message will be sent.

hint_select_tool.value: Нажмите стрелку или рамку, чтобы выбрать её: перетащите для перемещения, перетащите маркеры для изменения размера, кнопка Удалить удаляет её.
hint_select_tool.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: hint line between the toolbar and the screenshot while the Select tool is active; explains moving, resizing and deleting existing arrows and boxes.

hint_without_screenshot.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: hint line shown at the top when no screenshot could be captured, inviting the user to type their report in the message box below.

include_screenshot.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: checkbox label at the right end of the toolbar; untick to send the message without the screenshot.

message_label.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: bold heading above the multi-line text box where the user writes the feedback message, below the screenshot.

message_placeholder.value: Что произошло и чего вы ожидали? Добавьте всё, что поможет нам воспроизвести проблему.
message_placeholder.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: greyed hint inside the empty message text box prompting the user to describe what happened and what they expected.

message_required.value: Расскажите нам, что у вас на уме, перед отправкой.
message_required.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: red validation error shown after clicking Send with an empty message and no screenshot included.

message_too_long.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: red validation error shown after clicking Send when the message exceeds the server limit; {limit} is the maximum character count and {actual} the current length.

no_screenshot_captured.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: fallback reason, a lower-case fragment, inserted into “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when no screenshot exists and no specific failure reason is known.

redo_button.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: small button after Undo that re-applies the last undone annotation change.

screenshot_too_large.location: Send Feedback → Upload preparation: lower-case reason fragment inserted into the status-bar error when the annotated screenshot cannot be shrunk below the upload size limit, so the report is not sent.

screenshot_unavailable.value: Скриншот недоступен — {reason}. Ваше сообщение будет отправлено отдельно.
screenshot_unavailable.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: message shown in place of the screenshot canvas when the app window could not be captured; {reason} is a short lower-case cause, and the report will contain only the text.

select_tool.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: first tool toggle button, used to pick, move and resize existing arrows and boxes. Short verb.

select_tool_tooltip.value: Выбирать, перемещать и изменять размер аннотаций (V)
select_tool_tooltip.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: tooltip on the Select tool button; (V) is its keyboard shortcut and must stay.

send_button.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: primary footer button that validates the message and submits the feedback with the annotated screenshot, then closes the window.

undo_button.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: small button after the tool buttons that reverts the last arrow or black-box change on the screenshot.

dialog_title.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense: title of the dialog (or popped-out window) opened with F2 or the hint chip on the completion popup, used to report what the autocomplete should have suggested.

disabled_search_placeholder.location: IntelliSense → Feedback Report → Object selection: disabled search text shown while Include all owns object selection.

disclosure_capture.value: Ваша заметка, запрос и курсор, предложения всплывающего окна (с его изображением), как оно было вызвано, а также версия приложения и платформа.
disclosure_capture.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: first bullet listing the captured items — the user’s note, the query and cursor position, the suggestion list with an image of it, the trigger, and app version/platform.

disclosure_heading.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: bold heading above the bullet list that discloses exactly what data the report will upload.

disclosure_masked.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: bullet shown while “Mask literals” is on, stating that string literals and comments are replaced by the literal token <redacted> (keep that token as is).

disclosure_names.value: Имена (никогда данные) того, что вы отмечаете слева, плюс объекты, из которых пришли предложения, которые необходимы.
disclosure_names.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: bullet explaining that only names (never row data) of objects ticked in the left-hand tree are sent, plus the required objects behind the suggestions.

disclosure_never.value: Никогда: результаты, данные таблиц, учетные данные, ключи API или что-либо, что не отмечено.
disclosure_never.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: last bullet listing what is never uploaded — query results, table data, credentials, API keys, or unticked items.

disclosure_unmasked.value: Литералы и комментарии отправляются так, как набраны, если вы их не маскируете.
disclosure_unmasked.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: bullet shown while literals are unmasked, stating that string literals and comments in the query are sent exactly as typed.

expectation_placeholder.value: Что он должен был предложить? Добавьте любые детали, которые помогут нам воспроизвести это.
expectation_placeholder.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: greyed hint inside the note text box below the query, asking what the autocomplete should have suggested.

expectation_required.value: Скажите нам, что он должен был предложить.
expectation_required.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: red validation error under the note box shown when Submit is clicked with the note empty.

fk_chains_accessibility.value: Включайте цепочки связей внешних ключей с несколькими переходами в отчет
fk_chains_accessibility.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: screen-reader label for the “Relationship chains” checkbox, describing that it adds multi-hop foreign-key paths to the report.

fk_chains_label.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: small checkbox label after the object-kind toggles, shown only when foreign-key chains exist; adds multi-hop relationship paths between included tables.

include_all_accessibility.value: Включите всю модель данных соединений в отчет
include_all_accessibility.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: screen-reader label for the “Include all” checkbox beside the search box, describing that it sends the whole connection’s data model.

include_all_label.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: checkbox label next to the search box; when ticked, every object name in the data model is sent and the tree is greyed out.

include_all_summary.value: Вся ваша модель данных (только имена — никогда данные) будет включена.
include_all_summary.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree shown while “Include all” is ticked, replacing the ticked-item count.

kind_columns.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides columns in the tree (fifth of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_functions.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides functions in the tree (third of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_procedures.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides stored procedures in the tree (first of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_tables.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides tables in the tree (fourth of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_toggle_accessibility.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: screen-reader label for each object-kind visibility checkbox; {kind} is one of the lower-case plural kind words (tables, views, columns…).

kind_types.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides user-defined data types in the tree (last of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_views.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides views in the tree (second of six). Plural noun, very short.

mask_literals_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: small toggle button beside “Your query”, shown when the query has literals or comments; replaces them with <redacted> in the report.

mask_literals_tooltip.value: Заменить строковые литералы и комментарии на <redacted> перед отправкой
mask_literals_tooltip.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: tooltip on the “Mask literals” button explaining it hides string literals and comments behind the token <redacted> (keep that token).

no_data_model.value: Для этого соединения модель данных не зафиксирована.
no_data_model.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: empty-state message in the tree when no schema information was cached for the current connection.

no_search_matches.value: Ничто в вашей модели данных не соответствует "{query}".
no_search_matches.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: empty-state message in the tree when the search box text matches no object; {query} is the typed search text.

query_heading.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: bold heading above the read-only copy of the user’s query; {line} and {column} give the caret position when the autocomplete popup was captured.

required_badge.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: tiny accent-coloured tag at the end of a locked tree row whose object backed one of the suggestions and is always sent. Single short word, not an error.

required_explanation.value: Обязательный — это была часть предложений, которые вам предложили. Тесты, созданные на основе этого отчета, требуют этого для корректности.
required_explanation.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: tooltip on locked rows and notice under the tree after clicking one, explaining why that object cannot be unticked.

search_overflow.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: last row of the tree when search results are capped; {count} is how many further matching objects are hidden.

search_placeholder.location: IntelliSense → Feedback Report → Object selection: placeholder in the schema object search input.

selection_both_many.value: {picked} элементов отмечено плюс {required} требуется — отключенные поля отправляют только имя.
selection_both_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when several items are ticked and some are required; {picked} is the ticked count (plural), {required} the required count.

selection_both_one.value: {picked} элемент отмечен плюс {required} требуется — отключенные поля отправляют только имя.
selection_both_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when exactly one item is ticked plus some required ones; {picked} is 1, {required} the required count.

selection_none.value: Ничего не отмечено: имена моделей данных отправлены не будут.
selection_none.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked and no objects are required, so no schema names will be uploaded.

selection_picked_many.value: {picked} элементов отмечено — отключенные поля отправляют только имя.
selection_picked_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when two or more items are ticked and none are required; {picked} is the ticked count.

selection_picked_one.value: {picked} элемент отмечен — отключенные поля отправляют только имя.
selection_picked_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when exactly one item is ticked and none are required; {picked} is 1.

selection_required_many.value: {required} обязательных элементов из предложений будут отправлены.
selection_required_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked but two or more suggestion-backing items will be sent anyway; {required} is that count. Informational, not an error.

selection_required_one.value: {required} обязательный элемент из предложений будет отправлен.
selection_required_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked but exactly one suggestion-backing item will be sent anyway; {required} is 1. Informational, not an error.

snippets_group.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: name of the group row in the tree that lists the editor snippets known to IntelliSense.

submit_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: primary footer button that validates the note and queues the IntelliSense report for upload.

suggestions_summary.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: summary line at the top of the dialog when the captured popup had no top items to name; {count} is the number of suggestions recorded.

suggestions_summary_top.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: summary line at the top of the dialog; {count} is the number of suggestions recorded and {top} a comma-separated list of the first few suggestion names.

truncation_dropped_chains.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded in the report when it exceeds the size budget and all foreign-key chains are removed; {count} is how many were dropped.

truncation_dropped_objects.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded when the report is over its size budget and schema objects are cut; {dropped} removed out of {total} objects.

truncation_dropped_procedures.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded when the report is over its size budget and stored-procedure definitions are cut; {dropped} removed out of {total} procedures.

unmask_literals_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: label of the literals toggle button while masking is on; clicking it sends string literals and comments as typed again.

unmask_literals_tooltip.value: Отправлять строковые литералы и комментарии точно так же, как напечатано
unmask_literals_tooltip.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: tooltip on the “Unmask literals” button explaining that literals and comments will be sent exactly as typed.

capture_empty.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured window image has zero width or height.

capture_failed.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the operating system returns no image for the app window.

capture_truncated.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured image data is shorter than its declared size.

pixel_data_missing.value: захват окна не содержал пиксельных данных
pixel_data_missing.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured image carries no readable pixel bytes.

pixel_format_unsupported.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case technical fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the capture is not 8-bit, 32-bits-per-pixel colour.

pixel_layout_unsupported.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case technical fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the capture’s colour-channel order is not one the app can convert.

platform_unsupported.value: скриншоты ещё не поддерживаются на этой платформе
