column_name_column.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes grid: column header for the name of the changed result column (“(row)” for whole added/removed rows); also the CSV export header.

comparison_label.location: Results → Diff tab → Run picker row: dimmed label before the button that cycles through retained runs to choose the newer run compared against the baseline.

complete_another_run.value: Завершите другой отслеживаемый запуск для сравнения результатов.
complete_another_run.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when no baseline run is available yet, telling the user to run the query again (with difference tracking on) so two runs exist.

export_csv_button.location: Results → Diff tab → Show filter row: small button that saves the currently filtered typed-changes table to a CSV file via a save dialog; disabled until a comparison exists.

filter_added.location: Results → Diff tab → Show filter row: toggle chip that limits the typed-changes grid to rows only in the comparison run (added rows).

filter_all.location: Results → Diff tab → Show filter row: first toggle chip, selected by default, that shows added, removed and changed entries together.

filter_changed.location: Results → Diff tab → Show filter row: toggle chip that limits the typed-changes grid to individual cells whose values changed between runs.

filter_removed.location: Results → Diff tab → Show filter row: toggle chip that limits the typed-changes grid to rows only in the baseline run (removed rows).

incomplete_run_unavailable.value: Этот запуск не сохранил все строки, поэтому полное сравнение недоступно.
incomplete_run_unavailable.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when a selected run kept only part of its rows in memory, so a full comparison cannot be made.

key_column.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes grid: column header for the identifying key values of each entry (the chosen key columns joined by bars); also the CSV export header.

key_columns_label.location: Results → Diff tab → Key columns row: dimmed label before checkboxes for each result column; checked columns identify matching rows so changed cells can be detected.

no_differences.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes card: placeholder in the empty grid area when the two compared runs are identical.

no_snapshots_available.value: Снимки ещё не сохранены — используйте «Сохранить как снимок…» в таблице результатов.
no_snapshots_available.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown after clicking the Snapshot button when no saved result snapshots exist; refers to the grid command “Save as Snapshot…”.

preparing_changes.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes card: placeholder shown while the grid of differences is being built after a non-identical comparison.

removed_value.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes grid → Classification column: cell value marking a row present only in the baseline run (removed in the comparison).

retained_comparison_incompatible.value: Сравнительный запуск не имеет совместимого набора результатов в этом слоте.
retained_comparison_incompatible.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when comparing two retained runs and the comparison run has no result set at the active result tab’s position.

retained_run_count.location: Results → Diff tab → Run picker row: dimmed counter after the Comparison button; {run_count} is how many completed runs are kept in memory for comparing (up to 8).

run_label.location: Results → Diff tab → Baseline and Comparison buttons: name of one retained query run; {run_id} is its sequential run number.

safe_row_limit_unavailable.value: Этот запуск содержит {row_count} строк; безопасный предел сравнения {row_limit}.
safe_row_limit_unavailable.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when a selected run is too large to compare; {row_count} is its row count, {row_limit} the maximum rows allowed.

select_run.location: Results → Diff tab → Baseline and Comparison buttons: button label shown when no run is chosen yet; clicking cycles through retained runs.

selected_run_with_rows.location: Results → Diff tab → Baseline and Comparison buttons: label of the chosen run; {run_label} is e.g. “Run 3”, {row_count} its rows in the active result set.

show_label.location: Results → Diff tab → Show filter row: dimmed label before the All / Added / Removed / Changed filter chips.

slot_row_count_title.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes card: header line of the card; {title} is the card name (“Typed changes”), {row_count} the number of difference entries.

snapshot_comparison_incompatible.value: Сравнительный запуск не имеет совместимого набора результатов в этом слоте.
snapshot_comparison_incompatible.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when a saved snapshot is the baseline and the comparison run has no result set at the active result tab’s position.

snapshot_load_failed.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when the saved snapshot chosen with the Snapshot button cannot be read or parsed.

snapshot_named.location: Results → Diff tab → Run picker row: label of the Snapshot button when a saved snapshot is used as the baseline; {snapshot_name} is its name. Clicking cycles snapshots.

snapshot_none.location: Results → Diff tab → Run picker row: label of the Snapshot button when no saved snapshot is used as the baseline; clicking picks the first saved snapshot.

spill_backed_run_unavailable.value: Этот запуск использует вспомогательное хранилище; для сравнения потребуется материализовать полный результат.
spill_backed_run_unavailable.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when a selected run’s rows were spilled to disk because the result was large, so comparing would require loading it all.

summary_label.location: Results → Diff tab: summary line above the Typed changes card after a comparison; {summary} is the counts text such as “+3 added, -1 removed, ~2 changed, 10 unchanged”.

typed_changes_title.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes card: card name, inserted into its header with the entry count; the grid lists each added row, removed row and changed cell.

typed_row_match.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes grid → Key column: cell value used when no key columns are chosen, meaning rows were matched by comparing all their values.

whole_row_value.location: Results → Diff tab → Typed changes grid → Column column: cell value on added or removed entries, meaning the whole row rather than one column.

baseline_duplicate_key.value: Базовый запуск содержит дублирующийся ключ в строке {row_number}; выберите столбцы, которые уникально идентифицируют строки.
baseline_duplicate_key.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when the checked key columns repeat a value in the baseline run; {row_number} is the 1-based row with the duplicate.

baseline_null_key.value: Базовый запуск содержит NULL-ключ в строке {row_number}; выберите столбцы с не NULL-ключами.
baseline_null_key.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when a checked key column is NULL in the baseline run; {row_number} is the 1-based row with the NULL key.

comparison_duplicate_key.value: Сравнительный запуск содержит дублирующийся ключ в строке {row_number}; выберите столбцы, которые уникально идентифицируют строки.
comparison_duplicate_key.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when the checked key columns repeat a value in the comparison run; {row_number} is the 1-based row with the duplicate.

comparison_null_key.value: Сравнительный запуск содержит NULL-ключ в строке {row_number}; выберите столбцы с не NULL-ключами.
comparison_null_key.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when a checked key column is NULL in the comparison run; {row_number} is the 1-based row with the NULL key.

detailed_summary.location: Results → Diff tab: counts inserted into the “Diff Summary” line; {added_count}, {removed_count}, {changed_count} and {unchanged_count} are row counts. Keep the + - ~ signs.

incompatible_columns.value: Выбранные запуски имеют несовместимые имена или типы столбцов.
incompatible_columns.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when the baseline and comparison runs have different column names or data types, so rows cannot be compared.

key_column_missing.value: Ключевой столбец {column_position} не существует в этом результате.
key_column_missing.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when a checked key column does not exist in the compared result; {column_position} is the column’s 1-based position.

row_limit.location: Results → Diff tab: warning box shown when either compared run exceeds the comparison size limit; {maximum_rows} is the maximum rows allowed per run.

schema_mismatch_detail.location: Results → Automatic re-run comparison: detail when the previous and new run of a query have different columns; {old_count}/{new_count} are column counts, {old_columns}/{new_columns} name lists.

schema_mismatch_summary.location: Results → Automatic re-run comparison: summary when the previous and new run of the same query return different columns, so their rows cannot be compared.

summary.location: Results → Automatic re-run comparison: summary of rows added, removed and unchanged between the previous and new run of a query; the three placeholders are row counts. Keep the + and - signs.

connect_to_edit_rows.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы редактировать строки.
connect_to_edit_rows.location: Results → Grid → Row editing: message shown (in Messages or as the edit-pencil refusal) when trying to edit rows or apply a find-and-replace while the tab has no database connection.

command_palette_shortcut.location: Results → Empty state → Shortcut list: third row name, shown next to its keyboard shortcut chip, for the command that opens the Command Palette.

filter_explorer_shortcut.location: Results → Empty state → Shortcut list: fourth row name, shown next to its keyboard shortcut chip, for focusing the Explorer filter box.

new_query_shortcut.location: Results → Empty state → Shortcut list: second row name, shown next to its keyboard shortcut chip, for opening a new query tab.

run_query_prompt.value: Выполните запрос, чтобы увидеть результаты здесь
run_query_prompt.location: Results → Empty state: centered dimmed message under a table icon in the results area before any query has run, above the list of keyboard shortcuts.

run_query_shortcut.location: Results → Empty state → Shortcut list: first row name, shown next to its keyboard shortcut chip, for running the query in the editor.

pivot_sheet_name.location: Results → Export to Excel → Workbook: name of the extra worksheet holding the pivot table; {source_name} is the result set’s name. Excel sheet names are short, keep it brief.

copied_multiple_rows.location: Results → Export: success toast shown after a text format is copied to the clipboard from the Export menu or Export Results dialog; plural form, {row_count} is the number of rows copied (with thousands separators), {format_name} is the format name such as CSV.

copied_one_row.location: Results → Export: success toast shown after a text format is copied to the clipboard from the Export menu or Export Results dialog when exactly one row was copied; singular form, {row_count} is 1 and {format_name} is the format name such as JSON.

model_copied.location: Results → Export menu → model entries: success toast after a type definition (class/struct) built from the result's columns is copied; {language_name} is the programming language, e.g. C# or TypeScript.

no_result_set.location: Results → Export menu → model entries: info toast when a programming-language model entry is picked but the active result tab holds no result set to build the type definition from.

no_results.location: Results → Export: info toast shown when a format is picked to copy but the active result tab produced only messages (or shows History/DDL), so there are no rows to export.

preview_cell_warning_singular.value: Предупреждение: ячейка {preview_cell_count} в этом результате длиннее 8 КиБ и была получена как 8 КиБ предварительный просмотр, поэтому этот экспорт содержит предварительный просмотр. Чтобы экспортировать полные значения, используйте Экспорт таблиц… или Сохранить данные как в проводнике, запланированный экспорт запроса или `sqlly query` — они повторно выполняют запрос и записывают каждое значение полностью.
preview_cell_warning_singular.location: Results → Messages pane: warning added after a grid export when exactly one cell over 8 KiB was fetched only as a preview; explains the export holds the preview and lists exports that re-run the query for full values. {preview_cell_count} is 1.

preview_cells_warning.value: Предупреждение: ячейки {preview_cell_count} в этом результате длиннее 8 КиБ и были получены как 8 КиБ предварительные просмотры, поэтому этот экспорт содержит предварительные просмотры. Чтобы экспортировать полные значения, используйте Экспорт таблиц… или Сохранить данные как в проводнике, запланированный экспорт запроса или `sqlly query` — они повторно выполняют запрос и записывают каждое значение полностью.
preview_cells_warning.location: Results → Messages pane: warning added after a grid export when several cells over 8 KiB were fetched only as previews; plural form explaining the export holds previews and how to get full values. {preview_cell_count} is the number of such cells.

save_failed.location: Results → Export: error written to the Messages pane and shown as an error toast when saving exported results to a file fails; {file_path} is the target file, {error} is the operating-system error text.

spill_read_failed.value: Файл переполнения результатов не может быть прочитан — ничего не было экспортировано.
spill_read_failed.location: Results → Messages pane: error shown when a large result kept on disk (spill file) cannot be read back before an export or copy, so the action is abandoned and nothing is exported.

spill_truncation.value: Экспортированы первые {exported_rows} из {total_rows} строк. Очень большие результаты остаются на диске, поэтому для копирования и сохранения используется этот предел вместо загрузки каждой строки в память.
spill_truncation.location: Results → Export: truncation notice after exporting {exported_rows} of {total_rows} spill-backed rows, explaining why the on-disk result is not fully materialized.

update_missing_key.value: Столбец первичного ключа {column_name} отсутствует в результате; включите его в SELECT, чтобы копировать команды UPDATE.
update_missing_key.location: Results → Grid context menu → Copy as SQL UPDATE…: status-bar message when a primary-key column of the source table is missing from the result, so UPDATE statements cannot be built; {column_name} is that key column.

update_only_key_columns.value: Каждый проектируемый столбец является частью первичного ключа; включите неключевой столбец в SELECT, чтобы копировать команды UPDATE.
update_only_key_columns.location: Results → Grid context menu → Copy as SQL UPDATE…: status-bar message when every column in the result belongs to the primary key, leaving nothing to SET; asks the user to select a non-key column too.

all_rows_scope.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Header: one-word scope label replacing the rows × columns size when the user toggled from the current selection to exporting every visible row; means the whole result.

cancel_button.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Footer buttons: button that closes the dialog without exporting anything.

capped_notice.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Header: short parenthetical beside the size line when the whole large result exceeds the export row cap; tells the user the export will be truncated and the Messages pane will explain after exporting.

cli_copied_button.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Footer buttons: label the Copy CLI command button switches to after the command was copied to the clipboard; confirms the copy (past tense).

clipboard_destination.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Destination: option that puts the exported text on the clipboard; disabled for binary formats such as Excel.

copy_cli_button.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Footer buttons: button that copies a sqlly-cli shell command which re-runs this query into the chosen format (imperative command).

copy_cli_tooltip.value: Скопируйте строку запроса sqlly-cli (синтаксис POSIX shell), которая повторно выполняет этот запрос в выбранном формате. Доступно для SELECT-запросов, экспортируемых в CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines или Markdown.
copy_cli_tooltip.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Footer buttons: tooltip on the Copy CLI command button explaining it copies a POSIX shell sqlly-cli line and which query types and formats it supports.

destination_heading.location: Results → Export Results dialog: small section heading above the two destination choices (copy to clipboard or save to file).

enable_formats_instructions.value: Включите форматы в Настройки ▸ Результаты ▸ Экспорт.
enable_formats_instructions.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Format list: dimmed hint under the empty-list message telling the user where in Settings to turn export formats on.

export_all_tooltip.value: Экспортировать все строки вместо только выбранных
export_all_tooltip.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Header: tooltip on the small × button beside the size line, shown when a grid selection exists; switches the export from the selection to all rows.

export_button.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Footer buttons: primary button that runs the export with the chosen format and destination, then closes the dialog.

export_selection_tooltip.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Header: tooltip on the undo button beside the size line after switching to all rows; returns the export to only the selected cells.

file_destination.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Destination: option that saves the export to a file chosen in a save dialog; the ellipsis signals a follow-up dialog.

no_formats_enabled.value: Ни один формат экспорта не включен.
no_formats_enabled.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Format list: empty-state message shown in place of the format list when every export format is turned off in Settings.

open_spreadsheet_button.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Footer buttons: button that exports to a temporary file and opens it in the system's default spreadsheet app, then closes the dialog.

open_spreadsheet_tooltip.value: Экспортировать во временный файл и открыть его в программе для работы с таблицами по умолчанию
open_spreadsheet_tooltip.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Footer buttons: tooltip on the Open in Spreadsheet button explaining it writes a temp file and opens it in the default spreadsheet app.

programming_formats_heading.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Format list: small group heading above the code-snippet formats (C#, Python, TypeScript and other languages).

shape_many_rows_many_columns.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Header: size line showing how much will be exported; {row_count} rows and {column_count} columns, both plural (more than one).

shape_many_rows_one_column.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Header: size line showing how much will be exported; {row_count} is plural rows and {column_count} is exactly one column.

shape_one_row_many_columns.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Header: size line showing how much will be exported; {row_count} is exactly one row and {column_count} is plural columns.

shape_one_row_one_column.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Header: size line showing how much will be exported; exactly one row by one column (a single cell), both singular.

standard_formats_heading.location: Results → Export Results dialog → Format list: small group heading above the data formats (CSV, JSON, Excel, SQL and so on), as opposed to the Programming group.

window_title.location: Results → Export Results dialog: window title of the dialog opened from the grid context menu's Export… item to pick a format and destination.

csv.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; comma-separated values file. Usually kept as the abbreviation CSV.

html.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; rows written as an HTML table. Usually kept as HTML.

insert.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; rows written as SQL INSERT statements. INSERT is the SQL keyword and is usually not translated.

json.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; rows written as a JSON array of objects. Usually kept as JSON.

json_lines.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; one JSON object per line (JSONL). A format name; usually kept in English.

markdown.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; rows written as a Markdown table. Product name of the text format.

sql_values.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; rows written as a SELECT over a SQL VALUES list. VALUES is the SQL keyword.

sqlly_export.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; SQLLY's own portable .sqllyexport JSON file carrying column types and typed rows. SQLLY is the product name.

temp_table.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; script that creates a temporary table and inserts the rows into it, in the engine's own temp-table syntax.

tsv.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; tab-separated values. Usually kept as the abbreviation TSV.

xlsx.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; Microsoft Excel workbook file (always saved to a file, never copied). Excel is a product name; XLSX the file extension.

xml.location: Results → Export formats: format name listed in the Export menu, the Export Results dialog and the copied-rows toast; rows written as an XML document. Usually kept as XML.

no_formats_enabled.location: Results → Tab bar → Export menu: dimmed placeholder row shown in the dropdown when every export format is turned off in Settings, so there is nothing to pick.

open_spreadsheet.location: Results → Tab bar → Export menu: dropdown item that exports the active result to a temporary file and opens it in the system's default spreadsheet app.

toolbar_button.location: Results → Tab bar: “Export” text link at the right edge of the result tab bar that opens the Export dropdown menu of formats.

toolbar_tooltip.value: Экспорт результатов — выберите формат для копирования; удерживайте Shift, чтобы сохранить в файл
toolbar_tooltip.location: Results → Tab bar: tooltip on the Export link explaining that picking a format copies it and holding Shift while picking saves it to a file instead.

cancelled_before_finish.value: Запрос был отменен до его завершения
cancelled_before_finish.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase reason shown when an Export Tables or scheduled query export fails because the server reported the query cancelled before it finished; not the user's own cancel.

create_directory_failed.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase error when the destination folder for a saved, table or scheduled export cannot be created; {directory_path} is the folder, {error} the system error.

multiple_result_sets.value: запрос возвращает более одного результирующего набора; экспорт записывает один результат — сохраните каждый SELECT как отдельный запрос
multiple_result_sets.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase error when the query of a scheduled or table export returns more than one result set; an export file holds one result, so each SELECT must be saved as its own query.

not_streamable_format.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase error when an Export Tables or scheduled query export is asked for a format that cannot be written row by row; {format_name} is that format’s name.

rows_before_metadata.value: запрос вернул строки до метаданных столбцов
rows_before_metadata.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase internal-protocol error when the database sent rows before describing the columns during an Export Tables or scheduled query export.

spill_ended_early.value: файл переполнения запроса закончился после {offset} из {total_rows} строк
spill_ended_early.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase error when the on-disk overflow (spill) file of an exported query holds fewer rows than reported; {offset} is how many rows were read, {total_rows} the expected count.

spill_open_failed.value: не удалось открыть файл переполнения для экспорта
spill_open_failed.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase error when saving a large on-disk (spilled) result to a file cannot open its spill file, so the save stops.

stopped_before_completion.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase error when an Export Tables or scheduled query export's query stream ends without a completion signal, so the file would be incomplete.

tail_spill_open_failed.value: не удалось открыть файл переполнения запроса для завершения экспорта
tail_spill_open_failed.location: Background export to file → Failure reason: lowercase error when an Export Tables or scheduled query export cannot open the query's overflow (spill) file holding the remaining rows, so the export cannot finish.

condition_after_comma.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error under the input when a comma is followed directly by another comma or nothing usable, i.e. an OR term is missing its condition.

condition_expected.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error under the input when the expression ends where another condition was expected (for example right after a trailing comma); the English text currently duplicates the after-comma error.

date_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: noun phrase naming the column type “date”, inserted as {column_kind} into errors that say an operator or value needs a different column type.

date_value_wrong_column.value: для дат необходим столбец с датой, а не {column_kind}
date_value_wrong_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a date or relative-date value (2026-09-28, LAST WEEK) is compared with a column that is not a date column; {column_kind} names the actual column type.

empty_expression.value: введите выражение фильтра, например, status = active, created >= LAST WEEK
empty_expression.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red hint under the input when Apply expression is pressed with nothing typed; gives an example expression (status = active, created >= LAST WEEK) whose column names and keywords stay as-is.

first_condition_needs_column.value: первое условие должно указывать имя столбца
first_condition_needs_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when the expression starts with an operator instead of a column name; only later conditions may inherit the previous column.

invalid_date.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a value compared with a date column is not a date; {value} is what the user typed; the example dates show the accepted day, month and year forms.

invalid_number.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a value compared with a number column is not a plain decimal number; {value} is what the user typed.

missing_value_after_operator.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when an operator is followed by another operator instead of a value; {operator} is the operator symbol, e.g. >=.

missing_value_at_end.value: отсутствует значение — выражение прерывается посередине условия
missing_value_at_end.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when the expression ends right after a column and operator, with no value to compare against.

missing_value_before_comma.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a comma appears right after an operator where the comparison value should be.

month_start_unavailable.value: не удалось определить начало этого месяца
month_start_unavailable.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red error shown if THIS MONTH or LAST MONTH cannot compute the first day of the current month (a date-library edge case that should not normally happen).

negated_ends_with.value: отрицание ends-with не поддерживается — используйте !~ (не содержит) или != вместо этого
negated_ends_with.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error shown when the unsupported negated ends-with operator (!$) is typed; the English is currently just the operator name “ends-with”.

negated_starts_with.value: отрицание starts-with не поддерживается — используйте !~ (не содержит) или != вместо этого
negated_starts_with.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error shown when the unsupported negated starts-with operator (!^) is typed; the English is currently just the operator name “starts-with”.

not_must_precede_null.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error on a date column when the word NOT is followed by something other than NULL; NOT and NULL are keywords and stay untranslated.

number_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: noun phrase naming the column type “number” (integer or decimal), inserted as {column_kind} into errors saying an operator or value needs a different column type.

operator_or_value_required.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a column name is followed by nothing or a comma; {column_name} is the column that still needs an operator or a value.

range_operator_null.value: оператор '{operator}' требует значения, а не NULL — используйте = NULL или != NULL
range_operator_null.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a comparison operator such as < or >= is given NULL; {operator} is the operator; points to = NULL or != NULL instead.

range_operator_wrong_column.value: оператор '{operator}' требует числовой или дата-столбец, а не текстовый столбец
range_operator_wrong_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a comparison operator such as < or >= is used on a text column; {operator} is the operator symbol.

relative_period_invalid_unit.value: ожидалось WEEK, MONTH или YEAR после '{keyword}' — получено '{unit}'
relative_period_invalid_unit.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when THIS or LAST is followed by an unknown unit; {keyword} is THIS or LAST, {unit} the word typed; WEEK, MONTH, YEAR stay as keywords.

relative_period_missing_unit.value: '{keyword}' должно сопровождаться WEEK, MONTH или YEAR
relative_period_missing_unit.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when THIS or LAST on a date column is not followed by any unit word; {keyword} is THIS or LAST; WEEK, MONTH, YEAR stay as keywords.

saved_column_position.location: Results → Grid caption / Filter rows dialog → Saved filters: stand-in name for a column of an older saved filter that recorded only a position; {column_position} is the 1-based column number, listed among missing columns.

text_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: noun phrase naming the column type “text”, inserted as {column_kind} into errors saying an operator or value needs a different column type.

text_operator_date.value: оператор '{operator}' требует текстового значения, а не даты
text_operator_date.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a text operator (starts-with ^, ends-with $, contains ~) is given a date value; {operator} is the operator symbol.

text_operator_null.value: оператор '{operator}' требует текстового значения, а не NULL
text_operator_null.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a text operator (starts-with ^, ends-with $, contains ~) is given NULL instead of text; {operator} is the operator symbol.

text_operator_wrong_column.value: оператор '{operator}' требует текстового столбца, а не {column_kind}
text_operator_wrong_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a text operator (^, $, ~) is used on a number or date column; {operator} is the symbol, {column_kind} the column type phrase.

unexpected_operator.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when an operator appears where it is not allowed (for example ! followed by an unsupported operator); {operator} is the symbol typed.

unexpected_token.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when leftover text follows a complete condition; {token} is the stray word or symbol; conditions are separated by spaces (AND) or commas (OR).

unknown_quoted_column.value: неизвестный столбец "{column_name}" — ранее ни одно условие не указывает на этот столбец
unknown_quoted_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when the first condition starts with a double-quoted name that matches no result column; {column_name} is that name; the double quotes stay around it.

unknown_unquoted_column.value: неизвестный столбец '{column_name}' — ранее ни одно условие не указывает на этот столбец
unknown_unquoted_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when the first condition starts with a bare word that matches no result column; {column_name} is that word; the single quotes stay around it.

unquoted_operator_in_value.value: '{value}' сталкивается с '{operator}' — заключайте в кавычки значения, содержащие = ! < > ^ $ ~ (например, '{value}{operator}…')
unquoted_operator_in_value.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when an unquoted text value runs straight into an operator character; {value} is the value, {operator} the symbol; the quoted example must keep its punctuation.

unterminated_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a [bracketed column name] is missing its closing square bracket.

unterminated_string.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red parse error when a quoted value is missing its closing quote mark.

year_bounds_unavailable.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression input: red error shown if THIS YEAR or LAST YEAR cannot compute the year's start and end dates (a date-library edge case that should not normally happen).

add_condition_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Footer buttons: button that adds a new condition row at the top level of the filter (outside any group).

add_condition_in_group_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Condition group: small button at the bottom of a nested, indented group that adds a new condition row inside that group only.

add_group_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Footer buttons: button that adds a nested group of conditions with its own AND/OR choice.

any_text_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Condition row: label on a condition's column button when it searches across every text column instead of one named column.

apply_expression_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression row: button beside the typed-expression input that parses the expression into conditions (same as pressing Enter).

apply_grid_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Footer buttons: rightmost button that applies the conditions to the grid in the app; disabled for results too large to filter in memory.

apply_saved_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Saved filters row: button beside the saved-filters dropdown that loads the chosen saved filter's conditions.

apply_to_query_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Footer buttons: button that writes the conditions into the SQL editor's WHERE clause so the server filters; disabled when no editor is attached.

batch_default_notice.value: Настройки по умолчанию применяются только к отдельным инструкциям — результаты пакета не могут быть сопоставлены с одной таблицей. Сохраните фильтр и примените его по имени.
batch_default_notice.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Saved filters row: warning shown when Toggle default is used on a multi-statement batch, explaining defaults only work for single statements.

builder_action_title.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Apply to Query: internal name of the WHERE-clause edit that Apply to Query writes into the SQL editor; a short noun naming the filter builder.

clear_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Footer buttons: button that removes every condition row and group from the builder.

conjunction_all_and.location: Results → Filter rows dialog: option in the AND/OR dropdown at the top and in each group meaning a row must match every condition; AND is the SQL keyword.

conjunction_any_or.location: Results → Filter rows dialog: option in the AND/OR dropdown at the top and in each group meaning a row may match any one condition; OR is the SQL keyword.

default_filter_windowed_notice.value: Фильтр по умолчанию “{filter_name}” не был применен — этот набор результатов слишком велик для фильтрации в приложении; сузьте запрос.
default_filter_windowed_notice.location: Results → Filters: text “Default filter “{filter_name}” was not applied — this result set is too large to filter in the app; narrow the query instead.”.

delete_saved_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Saved filters row: button that deletes the saved filter chosen in the dropdown.

dialog_title.location: Results → Filter rows dialog: title of the dialog where users build, type, save and apply row-filter conditions for a result grid.

expression_placeholder.value: Выражение: status = active, создано >= ПОСЛЕДНЯЯ НЕДЕЛЯ
expression_placeholder.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Expression row: placeholder in the typed-expression input showing the syntax; the example column names and LAST WEEK keyword stay untranslated.

list_value_placeholder.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Condition row: placeholder in the value input when the operator is “in list” or “not in list”, showing values are separated by commas.

missing_column_noun.location: Results → Filter Rows → saved-filter warning: singular noun supplied as {noun} when exactly one referenced column is absent from the result.

missing_columns_notice.value: Сохранённый фильтр «{filter_name}»: пропущены условия на {column_list} — у этого результата нет таких {noun}.
missing_columns_notice.location: Results → Filter Rows: warning that conditions in saved filter {filter_name} were skipped because the result lacks {column_list}; {noun} is the localized singular or plural column noun.

missing_columns_noun.location: Results → Filter Rows → saved-filter warning: plural noun supplied as {noun} when multiple referenced columns are absent from the result.

non_iso_date_warning.value: {column_names} не отображается в формате ГГГГ-ММ-ДД, поэтому сравнения дат по нему ничего не дают в таблице. Установите для столбца формат даты yyyy-MM-dd или используйте Применить к запросу.
non_iso_date_warning.location: Results → Filter rows dialog: warning under the conditions when a date comparison targets a column not displayed as YYYY-MM-DD; {column_names} is a comma-separated list of those columns.

rename_failed.value: Не удалось переименовать «{old_name}» — введите новое имя, которое ещё не используется.
rename_failed.location: Results → Filters: error message “Could not rename “{old_name}” — type a new name that is not already taken.”.

rename_saved_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Saved filters row: button that renames the saved filter chosen in the dropdown.

save_named_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Saved filters row: button beside the filter-name input that saves the current conditions under that name.

saved_default_option.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Saved filters dropdown: entry label marking the saved filter that is applied automatically for this query; {filter_name} is its name.

saved_name_placeholder.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Saved filters row: placeholder in the small input where the user types a name before pressing Save.

toggle_default_button.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Saved filters row: button that makes the chosen saved filter the default auto-applied to this query's results, or removes that status.

unnamed_column.location: Results → Filter rows dialog → Condition row: fallback label on a condition's column button when the result column has no name; {column_number} is its 1-based position.

windowed_apply_query_hint.value: Этот результат больше окна в памяти; используйте Применить к запросу для фильтрации на сервере
windowed_apply_query_hint.location: Results → Filter rows dialog: dimmed hint at the top of the conditions list for a result too large to hold in memory; Apply is disabled, so it points to Apply to Query.

windowed_quick_filter_notice.value: Быстрые фильтры не могут работать с этим результатом — он слишком большой для фильтрации в приложении; сузьте запрос вместо этого.
windowed_quick_filter_notice.location: Results → Grid caption strip: notice shown above the grid when a quick filter from a cell menu or top-values window is refused because the result is too large to filter in the app.

windowed_result_notice.value: Этот набор результатов слишком велик для фильтрации в приложении; сузьте запрос вместо этого.
windowed_result_notice.location: Results → Grid caption strip: notice shown above the grid when a builder filter is dropped because the result became too large to filter in the app and no default saved filter is named.

close_tooltip.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar: tooltip on the X icon button at the far right of the find row; clicking it (or pressing Esc) closes the find and replace bar above the result grid.

find_placeholder.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar: placeholder in the search input beside the magnifier icon, shown while empty; typing highlights matching cells in the current result grid.

match_cap_coverage_note.value: Поиск остановлен на лимите из {match_limit} совпадений, поэтому последующие совпадения не были заменены; запустите «Заменить всё» снова, чтобы продолжить.
match_cap_coverage_note.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: note added after Replace All when the grid search hit its match limit, so cells beyond it were not replaced; {match_limit} is the maximum number of matches the search collects.

next_match_tooltip.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar: tooltip on the down-chevron icon button beside the search input that moves the focus to the next matching cell in the grid.

no_matches_to_replace.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: message added when Replace or Replace All is clicked but the current search has no matching cells in the grid to replace.

no_replaceable_matches.value: Нет заменяемых совпадений — совпадения в ключевых, только для чтения, не текстовых или вычисляемых столбцах пропущены
no_replaceable_matches.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: message added when every match sits in a column that cannot be edited (key, read-only, non-text, or computed columns), so nothing was replaced.

no_replaceable_matches_with_deleted.value: Нет заменяемых совпадений — совпадения в ключевых, только для чтения, не текстовых или вычисляемых столбцах пропущены ({deleted_count} в строках, подготовленных к удалению)
no_replaceable_matches_with_deleted.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: variant of the no-replaceable-matches message when some matches were also in rows already staged for deletion; {deleted_count} is how many such matches were skipped.

nothing_staged.value: Нечего добавлять в этап — замена совпала только со значениями, которые не будет изменять
nothing_staged.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: message after Replace or Replace All when every matched value would stay identical after the replacement, so no edit was staged.

nothing_staged_deleted.value: Нечего добавлять в этап — замена совпала только со значениями, которые не будет изменять ({deleted_row_count} совпадения пропущены: строка подготовлена для удаления)
nothing_staged_deleted.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: nothing-staged message variant when some matches were also skipped because their row is staged for deletion; {replacement_count} is the number of those skipped matches.

nothing_staged_skipped.value: Нечего добавлять в этап — замена совпала только со значениями, которые не будет изменять ({skipped_cell_count} совпавшие ячейки пропущены: нет ключа)
nothing_staged_skipped.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: nothing-staged message variant when some matched cells were skipped because their row has no key to identify it; {replacement_count} is the number of those skipped cells.

nothing_staged_skipped_deleted.value: Нечего добавлять в этап — замена совпала только со значениями, которые не будет изменять ({skipped_cell_count} совпавшие ячейки пропущены: нет ключа; {deleted_row_count} совпадения пропущены: строка подготовлена для удаления)
nothing_staged_skipped_deleted.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: nothing-staged message variant listing both skip reasons; {replacement_count} is cells skipped for lacking a row key, {update_row_count} is matches skipped because the row is staged for deletion.

previous_match_tooltip.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar: tooltip on the up-chevron icon button beside the search input that moves the focus back to the previous matching cell in the grid.

replace_all_button.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar → Replace row: short button at the end of the replace row that stages a replacement for every match at once; disabled when the search has no matches. Keep it brief.

replace_all_tooltip.value: Подготовить замену для каждого совпадения в редактируемых текстовых колонках
replace_all_tooltip.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar → Replace row: tooltip on the Replace All button explaining it stages edits for every match in editable text columns (changes are saved later like other staged edits).

replace_button.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar → Replace row: label of the button right after the replace-with input that replaces only the focused match as a staged edit; ideally a short verb such as “Replace”.

replace_placeholder.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar → Replace row: placeholder in the second input, below the search input, where the user types the text that will replace each match.

replace_tooltip.value: Замените выделенное совпадение на отложенное изменение (предварительный просмотр и сохранение как любое отложенное изменение)
replace_tooltip.location: Results → Grid → Find and replace bar → Replace row: tooltip on the single-replace button explaining it replaces just the focused match as a staged edit that is previewed and saved like any other.

replacements_staged.value: Отложенные {replacement_count} замены в {update_row_count} строках — предварительный просмотр и сохранение как любое отложенное изменение
replacements_staged.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: confirmation after Replace or Replace All staged edits; {replacement_count} is the number of cell replacements, {update_row_count} the number of rows they touch.

replacements_staged_deleted.value: Отложенные {replacement_count} замены в {update_row_count} строках — предварительный просмотр и сохранение как любое отложенное изменение ({deleted_row_count} совпадений пропущено: строка отложена на удаление)
replacements_staged_deleted.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: staged-replacements confirmation variant that also reports matches skipped because their row is staged for deletion; {skipped_cell_count} is that skipped count.

replacements_staged_skipped.value: Отложенные {replacement_count} замены в {update_row_count} строках — предварительный просмотр и сохранение как любое отложенное изменение ({skipped_cell_count} совпавшие ячейки пропущены: нет ключа)
replacements_staged_skipped.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: staged-replacements confirmation variant that also reports matched cells skipped because their row has no key; {skipped_cell_count} is that skipped count.

replacements_staged_skipped_deleted.value: Поставленные на редактирование {replacement_count} замены в {update_row_count} строках — предварительный просмотр и сохранение как любой поставленной на редактирование правки ({skipped_cell_count} совпавшие ячейки пропущены: нет ключа; {deleted_row_count} совпадения пропущены: строка поставлена на удаление)
replacements_staged_skipped_deleted.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: staged-replacements confirmation variant reporting both skips; {skipped_cell_count} is cells with no row key, {deleted_row_count} is matches in rows staged for deletion.

window_and_cap_coverage_note.value: Заменить всё охватывало только {loaded_rows} загруженных строк ({first_row}–{last_row} из {total_rows}); поиск остановлен на лимите в {match_limit} совпадений. Прокрутите для загрузки других строк и запустите снова, чтобы охватить их.
window_and_cap_coverage_note.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: note after Replace All on a large paged result when only the loaded rows were searched AND the match limit was hit; row numbers give the loaded range, {match_limit} the match cap.

window_coverage_note.value: Заменить всё охватывало только {loaded_rows} загруженных строк ({first_row}–{last_row} из {total_rows}); прокрутите для загрузки других строк и запустите снова, чтобы охватить их.
window_coverage_note.location: Results → Messages tab → Find and replace: note after Replace All on a large paged result when only the currently loaded rows were searched; {first_row}–{last_row} of {total_rows} is the loaded range.

add_column_button.location: Results → Formula bar: primary button at the right of the formula input when creating a new computed column; computes the column now and writes its directive into the query.

apply_tooltip.value: Вычислить столбец сейчас и записать его в запрос как -- столбец sqlly:
apply_tooltip.location: Results → Formula bar: tooltip on the Add Column / Update Column button explaining that it computes the column from the formula and adds its comment directive to the query.

cancel_button.location: Results → Formula bar: secondary button after Add Column / Update Column that closes the formula bar without adding or changing the computed column.

collapsed_column_name.location: Results → Formula bar → Read-only view: computed column's name followed by an equals sign, shown before its colored formula when a cell of a computed column is selected; {column_name} is that column's name.

column_name_placeholder.location: Results → Formula bar: placeholder in the narrow name input left of the equals sign, where the user names the new or edited computed column.

comment_delimiters_forbidden.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: error shown in red after clicking Add/Update Column when the name or formula contains the SQL comment markers /* or */, which would break the query comment.

default_computed_name.location: Results → Formula bar → Column name input: default name prefilled for a new computed column when no column named this way exists yet (the first, unnumbered default).

default_computed_name_numbered.location: Results → Formula bar → Column name input: numbered default name prefilled for a new computed column when earlier defaults are already taken; {column_number} is 2, 3, and so on.

edit_formula_button.location: Results → Formula bar → Read-only view: small button at the right of the strip shown when a computed column's cell is selected; opens the formula bar to edit that column.

formula_guidance.value: Введите формулу Excel — IF, COALESCE, TEXT, DATE, SUM… — с обращением к столбцам как !Name.
formula_guidance.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: dim hint shown while the formula input is still empty, explaining that Excel-style functions are allowed and columns are written as !Name.

formula_placeholder.location: Results → Formula bar: placeholder in the wide formula input right of the equals sign, shown when it is empty; the user types an Excel-style formula here.

invalid_name.value: Название столбца не может содержать = или перенос строки.
invalid_name.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: red error after clicking Add/Update Column when the computed column's name contains an equals sign or a line break.

name_required.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: red error after clicking Add/Update Column when the column name input is left empty (the message should say a name is required).

reference_guidance.value: Обращайтесь к столбцам как !Name, к предыдущей строке как !Name[1], к первой строке как !Name[$1].
reference_guidance.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: dim hint shown when the formula is valid but references no columns, reminding the user how to refer to columns in the formula.

spill_recompute_notice.value: Результаты {result_number} загружены с диска — выполните запрос снова, чтобы вычислить новые столбцы.
spill_recompute_notice.location: Results → Messages tab → Computed columns: notice when computed columns change but a result set is paged from disk, so its new columns need a rerun; {result_number} is the result set's number.

update_column_button.location: Results → Formula bar: primary button at the right of the formula input when editing an existing computed column; recomputes it and updates its directive in the query.

invalid_number.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a number literal cannot be read; {value} is the offending text.

invalid_row_number.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a fixed row reference such as !Name[$1] has something other than a whole number after $; {reference} is the text inside the brackets.

invalid_row_offset.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a relative row reference such as !Name[1] or !Name[-1] has a non-number inside the brackets; {reference} is the bracket text.

missing_name.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a column marker ! or a variable marker @ is not followed by a name; {marker} is the symbol ! or @.

row_numbers_start_at_one.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a fixed row reference uses $0 or a negative number; fixed rows are numbered from $1.

unclosed_quote.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a double-quoted text value or quoted column name has no closing quote.

unclosed_row_reference.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a row reference after a column (e.g. !Name[1) opens a square bracket that is never closed.

unexpected_character.value: “{character}” нельзя использовать здесь — обращайтесь к столбцам как !Name.
unexpected_character.location: Results → Formula validation: text ““{character}” can't be used here — refer to columns as !Name.”.

unknown_error_value.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when text after # is not one of the Excel error values such as #N/A, #DIV/0! or #VALUE!.

empty_formula.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when the formula has nothing after the equals sign.

missing_before_close_parenthesis.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error pointing at a closing parenthesis that has no value before it, e.g. an empty argument in SUM(1, ).

missing_before_operator.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when an operator appears where a value was expected; {operator} is the operator symbol, such as + or *.

missing_between_parts.value: Между этими двумя частями что-то пропущено — оператор или запятая?
missing_between_parts.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when two values sit side by side with nothing joining them; suggests an operator or comma is missing.

missing_operand.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error pointing at a comma or colon that has no value before it.

name_without_call.value: “{name}” не является вызовом функции или столбцом — столбцы записываются как !{name}.
name_without_call.location: Results → Formula validation: text ““{name}” isn't a function call or a column — columns are written !{name}.”.

range_needs_references.value: Диапазон требует ссылки на столбец с каждой стороны двоеточия.
range_needs_references.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a range such as !A:!B has something other than a column reference on either side of the colon.

unclosed_function.location: Results → Formula validation: parse error at the end of an unclosed call to {function_name}.

unclosed_parenthesis.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when an opening parenthesis is never matched by a closing one.

unexpected_end.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when the formula stops where a value was still expected, e.g. it ends with an operator or comma.

unmatched_close_parenthesis.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error pointing at an extra closing parenthesis that has no opening parenthesis before it.

placeholder.location: Results → Grid → Go to Column popover: placeholder in the search input, opened from the grid context menu or command; typing filters the column names to jump to.

binary_cell_placeholder.location: Results → Grid → Cells: text shown in a cell whose value is binary data instead of the raw bytes; {byte_count} is the size of the value in bytes. Keep the angle brackets.

no_rows_returned.location: Results → Grid: dim empty-state message centered under the column headers when the query succeeded but returned zero rows.

invalid_between.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment inserted into the “grid directive is ignored” warning when a between filter lacks “<a> and <b>”; {operand} is the text given. Lowercase; keep “and”.

invalid_freeze_count.value: freeze требует количества столбцов, а не “{value}”
invalid_freeze_count.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when freeze= is not a whole number of columns; {value} is the text given. Keep the keyword “freeze”.

invalid_label_setting.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when label= is not of the form column:display-column or column:off; {value} is the text given. Keep keywords.

invalid_number.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a numeric filter (e.g. >, between) is given a non-number; {value} is that text.

invalid_sort_direction.value: Направление сортировки должно быть asc или desc, а не “{direction}”
invalid_sort_direction.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a sort= column is followed by something other than asc or desc; {direction} is that word. Keep asc/desc.

missing_column_name.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a setting such as sort=, group=, filter= or label= is missing its column name. Lowercase fragment.

no_settings.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a “-- sqlly grid:” comment line has no settings after the colon. Lowercase fragment.

setting_not_key_value.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a semicolon-separated part lacks an equals sign; {setting} is that part. Keep “key=value”.

unclosed_quote.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a double-quoted column name has no closing quote; {value} is the setting text containing it.

unexpected_after_column.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when extra text follows a quoted column name; {unexpected} is the extra text, {column_name} the column.

unknown_filter_operator.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when filter= uses an operator that is not recognized; {value} is the filter text given.

unknown_setting.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a setting name is not one of order, hide, freeze, sort, group, filter or label; {setting} is the unknown name.

center.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Alignment submenu: menu item that centers this column’s values horizontally within their cells; middle option between Left and Right.

left.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Alignment submenu: menu item that aligns this column’s values to the left edge of their cells; first of the three alignment options.

right.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Alignment submenu: menu item that aligns this column’s values to the right edge of their cells; last of the three alignment options.

export.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: menu item near the bottom, above the Tools submenu, that opens the export dialog for the selected cells or rows, where the format and destination are chosen.

go_to.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Column submenu: menu item that opens a prompt for jumping to a column of the result by name; useful on very wide results.

hide_empty.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Column submenu: menu item that hides every column of this result whose values are all NULL; “all-NULL” explains what counts as empty.

narrow.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Column submenu: menu item right after Move Column Left/Right that makes the clicked column narrower by one step, as an alternative to dragging its header edge.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: submenu title grouping column-level commands such as hiding, resizing, going to a column and hiding all-NULL columns.

widen.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Column submenu: menu item right after Move Column Left/Right that makes the clicked column wider by one step, as an alternative to dragging its header edge.

add_column.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: menu item that opens the formula editor to add a new Excel-style computed column next to the clicked column; values are calculated in the grid, not by the database.

edit_formula.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: menu item shown only when the clicked column is a computed column; opens the formula editor so the user can change that column’s formula.

default_format.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: first copy menu item, copying the selection in the user’s default copy format; {format_name} is that format’s name, e.g. “TSV”, “CSV”, “JSON” or “Markdown”.

with_headers.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: menu item below the default Copy item that copies the selected cells to the clipboard with the column names as a header line.

format.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: one menu item per copy format other than the default one; {format_name} is the format’s name, e.g. “CSV”, “JSON Lines” or “SQL INSERT”.

headers.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: first menu item, which copies only the column names of the result (tab-separated) to the clipboard, without any values.

pretty_formatted.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Copy As submenu: menu item shown when the clicked cell holds JSON, XML or similar structured data; copies the value re-indented and pretty-printed.

sql_in_list.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: menu item shown when the selection is in a single column; copies the selected values as a SQL list ready for an IN (…) clause.

sql_in_list_distinct.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: like “Copy as SQL IN list” but removes duplicate values first; shown only when the selection is in a single column.

sql_update.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: menu item shown when whole rows or a clicked row are involved; opens a step to copy UPDATE statements built from the selected rows.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: submenu title, next to the Copy items, that lists the alternative copy formats, header-only copy and SQL list/UPDATE copies.

empty.location: Results → Messages tab: notice shown after a column value copy (distinct or top values) finds nothing to copy, e.g. the column is empty; the clipboard is left unchanged.

spill_sample_notice.value: Скопированы значения из первых {copied_rows} из {total_rows} строк — этот результат отображается с диска, остальное не было прочитано.
spill_sample_notice.location: Results → Messages tab: notice after copying a column’s values from a very large result kept on disk; {copied_rows} is how many rows were read and copied, {total_rows} the full row count.

load_binary_file.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item shown for binary cells; opens a file picker and stages the chosen file’s bytes as the cell’s new value.

save_binary_file.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item shown for binary cells; opens a save dialog and writes the cell’s raw bytes to a file on disk.

set_current_user.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for text cells that stages the database’s current-user SQL function as the new value, so the server fills in the login name; “(SQL)” marks a server-evaluated value.

set_default.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item that stages the keyword DEFAULT for the clicked cell, so the column’s database default is applied on save; keep “DEFAULT” as the SQL keyword.

set_false.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item shown only for boolean columns that stages the value false for the clicked cell; pairs with “Set true”.

set_local_timestamp.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for date or time cells that stages the current date and time read from this computer’s clock, not the server’s.

set_new_uuid.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for text cells that generates a new random UUID in the app and stages it as the cell’s value.

set_null.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: first menu item, staging NULL (no value) for the clicked cell; keep “NULL” as the SQL keyword.

set_server_date.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for date or time cells that stages the database’s current-date SQL function, evaluated by the server when the change is saved; “(SQL)” marks that.

set_server_time.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item, always offered beside Set NULL and Set DEFAULT, that stages the database server’s current time as the clicked cell’s new value.

set_server_uuid.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for text cells that stages the database’s UUID-generating SQL function, so the server creates the UUID when the change is saved.

set_true.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item shown only for boolean columns that stages the value true for the clicked cell; pairs with “Set false”.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: submenu title, shown when a data cell (not a row header) is right-clicked, grouping commands that stage a new value for that cell.

transform_action.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: one menu item per text transform for non-empty text cells; {transform_name} is the transform, e.g. “Uppercase” or “Trim whitespace”; stages the transformed text.

no_actions.location: Results → Grid → Context menu: single disabled placeholder item shown when right-clicking a spot in the grid where no command applies.

preparing_spill_rows.value: Подготовка экспорта — чтение {row_count} строк с диска…
preparing_spill_rows.location: Results → Grid → Caption strip above the grid: progress note shown while an export waits for rows of a very large result stored on disk; {row_count} is the number of rows being read.

active_to_where.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Filter submenu: menu item that turns the grid’s currently active column filters into a WHERE clause added to the query in the editor.

quick_contains.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that filters the grid to rows whose {column_name} contains the clicked value {cell_value}; changes the grid only, not the SQL.

quick_equals.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that filters the grid to rows where {column_name} equals the clicked value {cell_value}; changes the grid only, not the SQL.

quick_is_not_null.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that keeps only grid rows where {column_name} (the clicked column) has a value; offered even on NULL cells; changes the grid only.

quick_is_null.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that keeps only grid rows where {column_name} (the clicked column) is NULL; offered even on NULL cells; changes the grid only.

quick_not_equals.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that hides grid rows where {column_name} equals the clicked value {cell_value}; “<>” is the not-equal operator; grid only.

rows_builder.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Filter submenu: last menu item, opening the Filter Rows builder dialog for combining several column conditions on this grid.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: submenu title grouping quick grid filters on the clicked value, “Add WHERE …” query edits and the filter builder.

hide_column_label.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: menu item shown when this foreign-key column currently shows a label from the referenced row; turns it off for this column only.

hide_globally.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: last item, shown while labels are on; turns off the readable labels beside foreign-key values in every result grid.

off.location: Results → Grid context menu → Foreign Key Label: command that turns off the display-column label for the clicked foreign-key column.

show_column_label.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: menu item shown when this foreign-key column has no label; shows a readable label from the referenced row beside each key value.

show_globally.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: last item, shown while labels are off everywhere; turns on readable labels beside foreign-key values in every result grid.

use_display_column.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: item choosing which column of the referenced table supplies the label; {column_name} is that column’s name.

alignment_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: submenu title holding the Left, Center and Right options for horizontally aligning this column’s values.

cell_masking_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Format submenu: nested submenu title holding data-masking commands for the clicked cell’s column (reveal, re-mask, always/never mask, Masking Rules).

cell_override.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Format submenu: first menu item, opening the dialog that sets a display format override (number, date, etc.) for the clicked cell’s column.

cell_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: submenu title near the bottom, grouping the column formatting override and the masking commands for the clicked cell’s column.

conditional.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: menu item that opens the Conditional Formatting dialog for this column, where color rules based on cell values are set.

foreign_key_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: submenu title shown only for foreign-key columns that can show labels; holds choices for the readable label shown beside each key value.

header_override.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: first menu item, opening the dialog that sets a display format override (number, date, etc.) for the clicked column.

header_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: submenu title after Column and Values, grouping formatting override, conditional formatting, alignment, rounding, foreign-key label and masking for this column.

masking_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: last nested submenu title, holding data-masking commands for the clicked column (reveal, re-mask, always/never mask, Masking Rules).

rounding_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: submenu title shown for numeric columns that can carry decimals; holds choices for how many decimal places to display.

export.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: menu item above the Tools submenu that opens the export dialog for the result, where the format and destination are chosen.

canvas.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools → Layout submenu: menu item that switches how multiple result sets are arranged to a free-form canvas of movable panels.

reset_columns.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools → Layout submenu: menu item that restores this grid’s column widths and order to their defaults.

stacked.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools → Layout submenu: menu item that arranges multiple result sets stacked vertically, one grid under another.

tabbed.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools → Layout submenu: menu item that shows multiple result sets as tabs, one grid visible at a time.

always_mask_connection.location: Results → Grid context menu → Masking: command that adds a connection-level rule always masking {col_label}.

manage_rules.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Format → Masking submenu: last menu item, opening the Settings masking rules page where global data-masking rules are edited.

mask_connection.location: Results → Grid context menu → Masking: command that masks {col_label} on the current connection.

never_mask_connection.value: Никогда не маскировать {col_label} на этом подключении
never_mask_connection.location: Results → Grid context menu → Masking: command that adds a connection-level exception preventing {col_label} from being masked.

remask_result.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Format → Masking submenu: shown on a masked column; hides again every value that was revealed in this result.

reveal_cell.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Format → Masking submenu: shown only when the clicked cell is masked; shows the real value of that one cell.

reveal_column.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Format → Masking submenu: shown on a masked column; shows the real values of the whole column for this result only.

this_column.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Format → Masking submenu: fallback lowercase phrase inserted into the always/never-mask item labels when the column name is unknown; must read naturally mid-sentence.

export.location: Results → Pivot tab → Grid context menu: the only item on the pivot grid’s menu, opening the export dialog for the pivoted cells.

submenu.location: Results grid → Context menu → Tools submenu (Redis key listings such as SQLLY.KEYS): submenu holding actions on the selected keys.

delete.location: Results grid → Context menu → Tools → Redis Keys submenu: deletes the keys in the selected rows after a confirmation that lists them.

set_ttl.location: Results grid → Context menu → Tools → Redis Keys submenu: sets an expiry (TTL in seconds) on the keys in the selected rows.
